The incentives can be offered through a practical two-tier service subscription that offers users a discount in exchange for reduced carbon emissions. The discounted service option gives the AI provider the flexibility to serve some percentage of inference requests at a lower quality and higher latency during periods of high carbon intensity.

</details>


### [352] [Probabilistic Smoothing with Ratio-Monotone Transforms for Global Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27316)
*Kukyoung Jang,Taehyun Cho,Junrui Zhang,Ping Xu,Kyungjae Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种结合灵活对称单峰核与单调比率变换的通用概率平滑框架，无需递减平滑调度即可保持全局最优解，并提供随机梯度上升的显式复杂度界与方差缩减证明，在基准测试和对抗攻击中表现更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于高斯核的概率平滑方法对超参数敏感、鲁棒性有限，且需要特定的变换形式。作者希望设计一个更通用的平滑框架，降低超参数敏感性并提升鲁棒性。

Method: 提出通用平滑框架：结合灵活对称单峰核（不限于高斯）与单调比率变换。理论分析表明在温和条件下平滑目标保持全局最大点，且无需递减调度所有驻点集中在真优附近。给出随机梯度上升的复杂度界，并提出留一法基线用于方差缩减。

Result: 在高维基准测试和黑盒对抗攻击实验中，所提方法表现出更优的鲁棒性和竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 该通用平滑框架在保持全局优化理论保证的同时，有效克服了高斯核方法的超参数敏感性问题，为概率平滑提供了更灵活、更鲁棒的替代方案。

Abstract: Probabilistic smoothing is a standard tool for global optimization, but existing methods rely on Gaussian kernels and specific transforms, often resulting in strong hyperparameter sensitivity and limited robustness. We propose a general smoothing framework that combines flexible symmetric unimodal kernels with monotonic ratio-based transformations. Under mild conditions, we show that the smoothed objective preserves the global maximizer and that all stationary points concentrate near the true optimum for sufficiently large amplification, without requiring a decreasing smoothing schedule. We further provide explicit complexity bounds for stochastic gradient ascent and show that a leave-one-out baseline provably reduces variance. Experiments on high-dimensional benchmarks and black-box adversarial attacks demonstrate improved robustness and competitive performance.

</details>


### [353] [From Scores to Gibbs Correctors: Accelerating Uniform-Rate Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27352)
*Yuchen Liang,Ness Shroff,Yingbin Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Gibbs加速离散扩散模型（GADD），通过利用具体分数函数的结构构建Gibbs后验似然，无需额外训练即可加速离散扩散模型的采样。理论证明GADD达到O(polylog(ε⁻¹))的采样复杂度，是首个该速率保证的均匀率离散扩散模型。实验在合成数据、零样本文本采样和条件音乐生成中验证了其效率和质量的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型在文本等符号领域表现优异，但均匀率模型通常需要大量采样步骤才能生成单个样本，现有加速方法要么依赖额外训练量，要么存在混合慢的问题。

Method: 提出GADD方法，利用具体分数函数的结构直接构造Gibbs后验似然，无需超出标准分数估计的额外训练。理论分析采用归纳论证追踪预测器迭代中的误差传播并考虑校正器更新的不准确性，而非传统Girsanov测度变换技术。

Result: 理论证明了O(polylog(ε⁻¹))的总体采样复杂度，这是均匀率离散扩散模型的首个此类速率保证。实验表明GADD在合成数据、零样本文本采样和零样本条件音乐生成中一致优于标准基线（包括vanilla Euler方法和CTMC校正器），在样本质量和实际效率上均有提升。

Conclusion: GADD是一种无需额外训练的新型Gibbs校正器，能显著加速离散扩散模型采样。其理论分析框架为预测器-校正器方法建立了新的分析范式，具有独立的研究价值。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models have achieved strong empirical performance in text and other symbolic domains, but, especially for uniform-rate models, they often require many steps to generate a single sample. Existing acceleration methods either rely on training additional quantities or suffer from slow mixing. In this work, we propose a novel Gibbs-based corrector for discrete diffusion models, termed Gibbs-Accelerated Discrete Diffusion (GADD). GADD leverages the structure of the concrete score function to construct Gibbs posterior likelihoods directly, without requiring any additional training beyond standard score estimation. We show that GADD achieves an overall sampling complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{polylog} (\varepsilon^{-1}))$, yielding the first such rate for diffusion-based samplers for uniform-rate discrete diffusion models. We also conduct numerical experiments demonstrating the practical advantages of GADD across synthetic data, zero-shot text sampling, and zero-shot conditional music generation. These results corroborate the theory and show that GADD consistently improves sample quality and wall-clock efficiency over standard baselines, including vanilla Euler methods and CTMC correctors. Beyond this, our theoretical analysis introduces a novel framework for analyzing predictor-corrector methods in discrete diffusion models, which may be of independent interest. Unlike existing approaches that rely on the Girsanov change-of-measure technique, our method is based on an induction argument that tracks error propagation across predictor iterations while accounting for inaccuracies in the corrector updates.

</details>


### [354] [Guiding LLM Post-training Data Engineering with Model Internals from Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27354)
*Yi Jing,Zao Dai,Jinwu Hu,Zijun Yao,Lei Hou,Juanzi Li,Xiaozhi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAERL利用稀疏自编码器提取模型内部表示，建模数据多样性、难度和质量三个内在属性，用于强化学习中的数据工程，在GRPO上提升3.00%准确率并减少20%训练步数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的后训练数据工程主要依赖外部信号，忽略了模型内部蕴含的丰富内在信号，因此作者提出利用模型内部表示来指导强化学习中的数据工程。

Method: 使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从模型内部提取三种数据属性：多样性（通过SAE空间聚类+适度批混合实现）、难度（作为课程学习的代理指标）、质量（通过质量探针进行数据过滤），并将这些操作整合到GRPO等RL算法中。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B上，相比vanilla GRPO平均准确率提升3.00%，达到目标准确率所需训练步数减少20%，且在不同模型规模和RL算法上均有稳定提升。SAE在不同模型家族和规模间具有良好的迁移性。

Conclusion: 模型内部信号是后训练数据工程中一种强大且实用的信号来源，SAE可作为轻量级、可复用的数据工程工具。

Abstract: Model internals encode rich information about how a large language model (LLM) processes its training data; however, post-training data engineering largely relies on external signals and ignores rich intrinsic signals lying in model internals. We propose SAERL, a data engineering framework for LLM reinforcement learning (RL). It models three intrinsic data properties: diversity, difficulty, and quality, using model internals extracted with Sparse Autoencoder (SAE), an advanced mechanistic interpretability tool. Each property grounds a concrete data engineering operation: SAE-space clustering with moderate batch mixing for batch diversity control, a difficulty proxy for easy-to-hard curriculum ordering, and a quality probe for data filtering. SAERL improves average accuracy by 3.00% over vanilla GRPO and reaches target accuracy with 20% fewer training steps on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, with consistent gains across model scales and RL algorithms. Experiments show that SAE transfers effectively across model families and scales, serving as a lightweight and reusable data engineering tool. These results demonstrate that model internals are a powerful and practical source of signals for post-training data engineering.

</details>


### [355] [MobileMoE: Scaling On-Device Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27358)
*Yanbei Chen,Hanxian Huang,Ernie Chang,Jacob Szwejbka,Digant Desai,Zechun Liu,Vikas Chandra,Raghuraman Krishnamoorthi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MobileMoE，一系列面向设备端部署的MoE语言模型（0.3-0.9B激活参数，1.3-5.3B总参数）。通过制定设备端MoE缩放定律，发现适度稀疏+细粒度+共享专家是最优架构，并采用四阶段训练流程。在14个基准测试中，MobileMoE匹配或超越领先的密集模型（2-4倍更少FLOPs）和OLMoE-1B-7B（最多60%更少参数），并在真实手机上实现1.8-3.8倍prefill加速和2.2-3.4倍decode加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构在千亿参数大模型中已成为事实标准，但其在十亿参数以下、面向设备端部署场景的优势尚未被充分探索。现有工作缺乏针对移动设备（受限于内存和计算资源）的MoE缩放定律和架构设计指导。

Method: 1) 提出设备端MoE缩放定律，联合优化MoE架构在移动内存和计算约束下的表现，识别出"适度稀疏+细粒度专家+共享专家"的最优设计点；2) 基于该架构训练MobileMoE，采用四阶段训练流程（预训练、中期训练、指令微调、量化感知训练），全部使用开源数据集；3) 提供首个在商用智能手机上的高效MoE推理实现和完整profiling。

Result: 在14个基准测试中，MobileMoE匹配或超越领先的密集设备端LLM（推理FLOPs减少2-4倍），匹配或超越SOTA MoE模型OLMoE-1B-7B（参数减少60%）。在INT4权重量化下，MobileMoE-S相较密集基线MobileLLM-Pro实现1.8-3.8倍prefill加速和2.2-3.4倍decode加速。

Conclusion: MoE架构在十亿参数以下规模同样具有显著优势，通过合理的缩放定律和架构设计，可以在移动设备上实现内存和计算双重高效的LLM部署，建立新的Pareto前沿。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become the de facto architecture for hundred-billion-parameter language models, yet its advantages at sub-billion scales for on-device deployment remain largely unexplored. To close this gap, we present MobileMoE, a family of on-device MoE language models with sub-billion active parameters (0.3-0.9B active and 1.3-5.3B total) that establish a new Pareto frontier for on-device LLMs. We first formulate an on-device MoE scaling law that jointly optimizes MoE architecture under mobile memory and compute constraints, identifying an on-device sweet spot - moderate sparsity with fine-grained and shared experts - that is simultaneously memory and compute-optimal. Building on the derived architectures, we train MobileMoE with a four-stage recipe covering pre-training, mid-training, instruction fine-tuning, and quantization-aware training, all on open-source datasets. Across 14 benchmarks, MobileMoE matches or exceeds leading on-device dense LLMs with 2-4$\times$ fewer inference FLOPs, and matches or surpasses the state-of-the-art MoE OLMoE-1B-7B with up to 60% fewer parameters. To bridge the last mile to mobile deployment, we provide the first efficient MoE inference on commodity smartphones with comprehensive on-device profiling. At comparable INT4 weight memory, MobileMoE-S delivers $1.8$-$3.8\times$ faster prefill and $2.2$-$3.4\times$ faster decode than the dense baseline MobileLLM-Pro.

</details>


### [356] [Reformulation of RBM to Unify Linear and Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.08210)
*Jiangsheng You,Chun-Yen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过MAP估计和EM算法证明无MCMC的对比散度算法在条件似然目标函数下是收敛的，并将RBM重构成确定性模型，支持标量和向量节点及灵活激活函数，在线性和非线性降维中均有出色表现，尤其在CIFAR-10和多元序列数据上展示了传统RBM无法自然配置的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统RBM需要概率解释和MCMC采样，对比散度算法虽高效但缺乏收敛性数学证明，且传统RBM难以处理向量值节点。本文旨在从理论上证明CD算法的收敛性，并将RBM重构成确定性模型以扩展其应用范围。

Method: 利用最大后验估计和期望最大化算法证明无MCMC的CD算法收敛；将RBM重新表述为确定性模型，无需MCMC采样，CD算法退化为梯度下降法；支持连续标量和向量节点，可灵活选择激活函数。

Result: 重构的RBM在线性和非线性降维中均有效；非线性降维中选择合适的激活函数可超越PCA；成功应用于CIFAR-10彩色图像和多元序列数据的向量值节点，这是传统RBM难以自然实现的。

Conclusion: 本文不仅为传统RBM提供了理论见解，还统一了标量和向量变量的线性与非线性降维方法。

Abstract: A restricted Boltzmann machine (RBM) is a two-layer neural network with shared weights and has been extensively studied for dimensionality reduction, data representation and recommendation systems in the literature. The traditional RBM requires a probabilistic interpretation of the values on both layers and a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) procedure to generate samples during the training. The contrastive divergence (CD) is efficient to train the RBM but its convergence has not been proved mathematically. In this paper, using a maximum a posteriori (MAP) estimate and the expectation maximization (EM) algorithm, we show that the CD algorithm without MCMC is convergent for the conditional likelihood object function. Another key contribution in this paper is the reformulation of the RBM into a deterministic model. Within the reformulated RBM, the CD algorithm without MCMC approximates the gradient descent (GD) method. This reformulated RBM can take the continuous scalar and vector variables on the nodes with flexibility in choosing the activation functions. Numerical experiments show its capability in both linear and nonlinear dimensionality reduction, and, for the nonlinear dimensionality reduction, the reformulated RBM can outperform principal component analysis (PCA) by choosing the proper activation functions. Finally, we demonstrate its application to vector-valued nodes for the CIFAR-10 dataset (color images) and the multivariate sequence data, which cannot be configured naturally with the traditional RBM. This work not only provides theoretical insights regarding the traditional RBM but also unifies the linear and nonlinear dimensionality reduction for scalar and vector variables.

</details>


### [357] [Efficient Learning of Mesh-Based Physical Simulation with BSMS-GNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.02573)
*Yadi Cao,Menglei Chai,Minchen Li,Chenfanfu Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BSMS-GNN框架，通过基于BFS交替前沿的bi-stride池化策略实现多尺度图神经网络物理仿真，无需人工绘制粗网格且避免空间邻近导致的错误边，在精度和计算效率上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模网格上的物理仿真中，平坦GNN和堆叠消息传递面临节点数量扩展复杂度过高和过平滑问题。现有引入多尺度结构的方法依赖人工绘制粗网格或基于空间邻近构建粗化层级，劳动密集且在几何边界处引入错误边，亟需一种无需人工且边界感知的池化策略。

Method: 受二分图确定启发，提出bi-stride池化策略：在广度优先搜索(BFS)的交替前沿上进行节点池化，无需手动绘制粗网格，并避免空间邻近导致的跨几何边界的错误连接。该方法支持每层级单次消息传递方案，以及通过插值实现非参数化的池化与解池化（类似U-Net架构），显著降低计算成本。

Result: 在代表性物理仿真任务中，BSMS-GNN框架在精度和计算效率两方面均显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: BSMS-GNN通过bi-stride池化策略有效解决了大规模网格物理仿真中的多尺度GNN学习难题，既避免了人工标注粗网格的负担，又克服了空间邻近方法的边界错误问题，为物理仿真领域的GNN应用提供了更高效、更准确的解决方案。

Abstract: Learning the physical simulation on large-scale meshes with flat Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and stacking Message Passings (MPs) is challenging due to the scaling complexity w.r.t. the number of nodes and over-smoothing. There has been growing interest in the community to introduce \textit{multi-scale} structures to GNNs for physical simulation. However, current state-of-the-art methods are limited by their reliance on the labor-intensive drawing of coarser meshes or building coarser levels based on spatial proximity, which can introduce wrong edges across geometry boundaries. Inspired by the bipartite graph determination, we propose a novel pooling strategy, \textit{bi-stride} to tackle the aforementioned limitations. Bi-stride pools nodes on every other frontier of the breadth-first search (BFS), without the need for the manual drawing of coarser meshes and avoiding the wrong edges by spatial proximity. Additionally, it enables a one-MP scheme per level and non-parametrized pooling and unpooling by interpolations, resembling U-Nets, which significantly reduces computational costs. Experiments show that the proposed framework, \textit{BSMS-GNN}, significantly outperforms existing methods in terms of both accuracy and computational efficiency in representative physical simulations.

</details>


### [358] [Towards Interpretable Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.13473)
*Anran Li,Rui Liu,Ming Hu,Yuanyuan Chen,Shipeng Wang,Lizhen Cui,Han Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统综述了可解释联邦学习（IFL）领域，提出了独特的IFL分类体系，涵盖模型预测解释、调试支持及数据贡献评估等关键方向，并分析了代表性方法、性能指标与未来发展方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习在金融、医疗等关键任务应用中需要在性能、隐私保护和可解释性之间取得平衡，但现有研究缺乏对可解释联邦学习的系统梳理，新研究者难以快速入门这一跨学科领域。

Method: 提出首个IFL分类体系，从模型预测解释、模型调试支持、数据贡献洞察三个维度对现有工作进行分类；对代表性方法、常用性能评估指标进行综合分析。

Result: 形成了系统化的IFL研究框架，明确了该领域的核心研究方向、现有方法的优劣及评估体系。

Conclusion: 该综述为IFL领域提供了基础性参考，指出了构建通用IFL技术的若干有前景的研究方向，有助于推动联邦学习在关键应用中的广泛采用。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables multiple data owners to build machine learning models collaboratively without exposing their private local data. In order for FL to achieve widespread adoption, it is important to balance the need for performance, privacy-preservation and interpretability, especially in mission critical applications such as finance and healthcare. Thus, interpretable federated learning (IFL) has become an emerging topic of research attracting significant interest from the academia and the industry alike. Its interdisciplinary nature can be challenging for new researchers to pick up. In this paper, we bridge this gap by providing (to the best of our knowledge) the first survey on IFL. We propose a unique IFL taxonomy which covers relevant works enabling FL models to explain the prediction results, support model debugging, and provide insights into the contributions made by individual data owners or data samples, which in turn, is crucial for allocating rewards fairly to motivate active and reliable participation in FL. We conduct comprehensive analysis of the representative IFL approaches, the commonly adopted performance evaluation metrics, and promising directions towards building versatile IFL techniques.

</details>


### [359] [Incremental Gauss-Newton Descent for Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.05560)
*Mikalai Korbit,Mario Zanon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出增量高斯-牛顿下降法（IGND），在逐样本标量损失场景下，将阻尼高斯-牛顿方向简化为随机梯度的闭式标量归一化，无需存储、分解或迭代求解曲率矩阵，并在理论上证明了驻点收敛性，实验表明其对灵敏度缩放具有鲁棒性且可与常见随机优化器竞争或互补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机梯度更新的有效步长严重依赖特征缩放和局部模型灵敏度，而标准高斯-牛顿方法虽能通过曲率信息解决缩放问题，但在小批量形式下需要矩阵-向量乘积、线性求解或结构化近似，计算代价高。本文旨在探索逐样本标量损失这一特殊设置下，高斯-牛顿方向能否简化为更高效的形式。

Method: 针对标量输出损失且每次只处理一个样本的场景，利用广义高斯-牛顿矩阵秩至多为1且唯一非零曲率方向与随机梯度方向对齐的性质，将阻尼高斯-牛顿方向推导为随机梯度的闭式标量归一化，得到增量高斯-牛顿下降法（IGND）。该方法无需存储曲率矩阵、矩阵分解或迭代线性求解。

Result: 在显式光滑性、对齐性和随机逼近假设下，证明了IGND更新的驻点收敛结果。在监督学习、缩放鲁棒性控制实验和线性二次型控制案例中，IGND对灵敏度缩放表现出更强的鲁棒性，并能与常见随机优化器竞争或互补，同时保持简单的增量更新形式。

Conclusion: IGND在逐样本标量损失场景下为高斯-牛顿方法提供了一种计算高效的替代方案，兼具曲率感知的步长自适应能力和随机梯度下降的简洁性，为后续在更大规模或更复杂场景下的扩展奠定了基础。

Abstract: Stochastic gradient updates are widely used for their efficiency and scalability, but their effective step sizes can depend strongly on feature scaling and local model sensitivity. Gauss-Newton methods address such scale effects through curvature information, but in their standard mini-batch form they require matrix-vector products, linear solves, or structured approximations. This paper studies the special case of scalar-output losses evaluated one sample at a time. In this setting, the generalized Gauss-Newton matrix has rank at most one, and its only possible nonzero curvature direction is aligned with the stochastic gradient. As a result, the damped Gauss-Newton direction reduces to a closed-form scalar normalization of the sample gradient. The resulting update, Incremental Gauss-Newton Descent (IGND), requires no curvature matrix storage, factorization, or iterative linear solve. We derive the update, characterize its behavior, and relate it to normalized gradient descent, adaptive first-order methods, stochastic Polyak step sizes, and mini-batch Gauss-Newton updates. Under explicit smoothness, alignment, and stochastic approximation assumptions, we prove a stationarity result for the IGND update. Experiments on supervised learning, a controlled test of scale robustness, and a linear-quadratic control case study show that IGND improves robustness to sensitivity scaling and can be competitive with, or complementary to, common stochastic optimizers while retaining a simple incremental update.

</details>


### [360] [Neural Scaling Laws of Deep ReLU and Deep Operator Network: A Theoretical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.00357)
*Hao Liu,Zecheng Zhang,Wenjing Liao,Hayden Schaeffer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了深度算子网络（特别是DeepONet架构）在函数空间学习中的神经缩放定律理论框架，通过分析逼近误差和泛化误差，量化了网络模型大小、训练数据规模与误差之间的关系，并针对输入函数具有低维结构的情况给出了更紧的误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经缩放定律在各类深度学习任务中被广泛观察到，但缺乏完整的理论解释。本文旨在为深度算子网络中的缩放定律提供理论框架，解释模型规模和数据规模如何影响学习性能。

Method: 聚焦Chen和Chen架构（包括DeepONet），通过理论分析逼近误差和泛化误差，建立误差与网络模型大小、训练数据量之间的量化关系，并针对输入函数的低维结构推导更紧的误差界。

Result: 建立了深度算子网络中神经缩放定律的理论框架，量化了逼近/泛化误差与模型大小、数据规模的关系，在低维结构下获得了更紧的误差界，且结果适用于深度ReLU网络等类似架构。

Conclusion: 为算子学习中的神经缩放定律提供了部分理论解释，为相关应用奠定了理论基础。

Abstract: Neural scaling laws play a pivotal role in the performance of deep neural networks and have been observed in a wide range of tasks. However, a complete theoretical framework for understanding these scaling laws remains underdeveloped. In this paper, we explore the neural scaling laws for deep operator networks, which involve learning mappings between function spaces, with a focus on the Chen and Chen style architecture. These approaches, which include the popular Deep Operator Network (DeepONet), approximate the output functions using a linear combination of learnable basis functions and coefficients that depend on the input functions. We establish a theoretical framework to quantify the neural scaling laws by analyzing its approximation and generalization errors. We articulate the relationship between the approximation and generalization errors of deep operator networks and key factors such as network model size and training data size. Moreover, we address cases where input functions exhibit low-dimensional structures, allowing us to derive tighter error bounds. These results also hold for deep ReLU networks and other similar structures. Our results offer a partial explanation of the neural scaling laws in operator learning and provide a theoretical foundation for their applications.

</details>


### [361] [CktGen: Automated Analog Circuit Design with Generative Artificial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.00995)
*Yuxuan Hou,Hehe Fan,Jianrong Zhang,Yue Zhang,Hua Chen,Min Zhou,Faxin Yu,Roger Zimmermann,Yi Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CktGen，一种基于规范条件的变分自编码器，用于模拟电路自动生成。通过解耦电路与规范的编码、对比训练和分类器引导，在开放电路基准上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模拟电路综合方法多为单目标优化，忽视了同一电路类型的设计规范在不同应用中差异很大。本文旨在利用已有优质电路来提升模拟电路设计的自动化水平。

Method: 提出CktGen，一种规范条件的变分自编码器：(1) 将离散化的规范和电路映射到联合潜空间；(2) 解耦电路和规范的编码并对齐潜空间；(3) 采用带滤波掩码的对比训练最大化编码差异；(4) 使用分类器引导和潜特征对齐促进同规范电路的聚类，避免模型坍塌为单一映射。

Result: 在开放电路基准上进行全面实验，引入跨模型一致性评估指标，结果表明CktGen显著优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过规范化潜空间使其关于规范条件具有一致性，可以搜索出满足目标规范的最优电路，有效解决规范到电路的一对多映射问题。

Abstract: The automatic synthesis of analog circuits presents significant challenges. Most existing approaches formulate the problem as a single-objective optimization task, overlooking that design specifications for a given circuit type vary widely across applications. To address this, we introduce specification-conditioned analog circuit generation, a task that directly generates analog circuits based on target specifications. The motivation is to leverage existing well-designed circuits to improve automation in analog circuit design. Specifically, we propose CktGen, a simple yet effective variational autoencoder that maps discretized specifications and circuits into a joint latent space and reconstructs the circuit from that latent vector. Notably, as a single specification may correspond to multiple valid circuits, naively fusing specification information into the generative model does not capture these one-to-many relationships. To address this, we decouple the encoding of circuits and specifications and align their mapped latent space. Then, we employ contrastive training with a filter mask to maximize differences between encoded circuits and specifications. Furthermore, classifier guidance along with latent feature alignment promotes the clustering of circuits sharing the same specification, avoiding model collapse into trivial one-to-one mappings. By canonicalizing the latent space with respect to specifications, we can search for an optimal circuit that meets valid target specifications. We conduct comprehensive experiments on the open circuit benchmark and introduce metrics to evaluate cross-model consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that CktGen achieves substantial improvements over state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [362] [CHESTNUT: A QoS Dataset for Mobile Edge Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.19248)
*Guobing Zou,Fei Zhao,Shengxiang Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有QoS数据集（如WS-Dream）主要关注静态指标，忽略了时间和地理位置等动态属性。本文提出了一个在采集过程中精确记录时间和地理位置信息的新型QoS数据集，以支持移动边缘环境中的QoS预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数现有QoS数据集仅关注静态服务指标，缺乏时间和地理位置等动态属性信息，而这些属性对于理解和预测网络服务的实际性能至关重要。

Method: 提出一个新型数据集，在数据采集过程中精确记录服务质量的时间戳和地理位置信息。

Result: 生成了一个包含时间和地理位置信息的动态QoS数据集。

Conclusion: 该数据集旨在为移动边缘环境中的QoS预测提供更准确、更可靠的数据支持。

Abstract: Quality of Service (QoS) is an important metric to measure the performance of network services. Nowadays, it is widely used in mobile edge environments to evaluate the quality of service when mobile devices request services from edge servers. QoS usually involves multiple dimensions, such as bandwidth, latency, jitter, and data packet loss rate. However, most existing QoS datasets, such as the common WS-Dream dataset, focus mainly on static QoS metrics of network services and ignore dynamic attributes such as time and geographic location. This means they should have detailed the mobile device's location at the time of the service request or the chronological order in which the request was made. However, these dynamic attributes are crucial for understanding and predicting the actual performance of network services, as QoS performance typically fluctuates with time and geographic location. To this end, we propose a novel dataset that accurately records temporal and geographic location information on quality of service during the collection process, aiming to provide more accurate and reliable data to support future QoS prediction in mobile edge environments.

</details>


### [363] ["Give Me BF16 or Give Me Death"? Accuracy-Performance Trade-Offs in LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.02355)
*Eldar Kurtic,Alexandre Marques,Shubhra Pandit,Mark Kurtz,Dan Alistarh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过对Llama-3.1全系列模型进行超过50万次评估，系统比较了FP8、INT8和INT4三种量化格式在精度与性能之间的权衡，并基于vLLM框架给出了不同部署场景下的最优量化格式推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前缺乏对不同量化格式（FP8、INT8、INT4）在准确率与性能之间权衡的全面且系统的实证研究，导致实际部署时缺乏数据驱动的决策依据。

Method: 在Llama-3.1全系列模型上，对FP8(W8A8-FP)、INT8(W8A8-INT)和INT4(W4A16-INT)三种量化格式进行超过50万次评估，涵盖学术基准和实际任务，并通过vLLM框架分析推理性能。

Result: (1) FP8 (W8A8-FP) 在所有规模上几乎无损；(2) 精心调优的INT8 (W8A8-INT) 准确率损失仅为1-3%；(3) INT4权重量化 (W4A16-INT) 表现超出预期，可与8-bit量化竞争。

Conclusion: W4A16在同步部署中成本效率最高，W8A8在异步连续批处理中占据主导地位，混合工作负载下的最优选择取决于具体场景。

Abstract: Quantization is a powerful tool for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference, but the accuracy-performance trade-offs across different formats remain unclear. In this paper, we conduct the most comprehensive empirical study to date, evaluating FP8, INT8, and INT4 quantization across academic benchmarks and real-world tasks on the entire Llama-3.1 model family. Through over 500,000 evaluations, our investigation yields several key findings: (1) FP8 (W8A8-FP) is effectively lossless across all model scales, (2) well-tuned INT8 (W8A8-INT) achieves surprisingly low (1-3\%) accuracy degradation, and (3) INT4 weight-only (W4A16-INT) is more competitive than expected, rivaling 8-bit quantization. Further, we investigate the optimal quantization format for different deployments by analyzing inference performance through the popular vLLM framework. Our analysis provides clear deployment recommendations: W4A16 is the most cost-efficient for synchronous setups, while W8A8 dominates in asynchronous continuous batching. For mixed workloads, the optimal choice depends on the specific use case. Our findings offer practical, data-driven guidelines for deploying quantized LLMs at scale -- ensuring the best balance between speed, efficiency, and accuracy.

</details>


### [364] [Evaluating Sample Utility for Efficient Data Selection by Mimicking Model Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06708)
*Tzu-Heng Huang,Manjot Bilkhu,John Cooper,Frederic Sala,Javier Movellan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Mimic Score和Grad-Mimic框架，通过基于几何的数据质量度量（衡量样本梯度与预训练参考模型目标方向的对齐程度）实现无需验证集、低计算开销的数据筛选与训练加速，在图像数据集上取得一致性能提升，并以更少训练步骤和样本量改进CLIP模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模网络爬取数据集存在噪声、偏差和无关信息，现有数据选择方法依赖手工启发式、下游数据集或昂贵的基于影响的计算，这些方法限制了可扩展性并引入了不必要的数据依赖。

Method: 提出Mimic Score作为基于几何的数据质量度量，通过计算样本梯度与预训练参考模型诱导的目标方向之间的对齐程度来评估效用；在此基础上构建Grad-Mimic两阶段框架：在线阶段对样本进行重加权以加速训练，离线阶段聚合样本效用以构建有效的数据过滤器。

Result: 在六个图像数据集上取得一致的性能提升；CLIP模型训练步骤减少20.7%；基于Mimic Score的过滤器在现有过滤技术基础上进一步改进CLIP模型，使用少470万个样本即可达到同等性能。

Conclusion: Mimic Score和Grad-Mimic框架是一种简单、几何驱动的数据质量评估与选择方法，无需验证集和额外数据依赖，计算开销小，能有效提升数据效率和训练速度。

Abstract: Large-scale web-crawled datasets contain noise, bias, and irrelevant information, necessitating data selection techniques. Existing methods depend on hand-crafted heuristics, downstream datasets, or require expensive influence-based computations -- all of which limit scalability and introduce unwanted data dependencies. To address this, we introduce the Mimic Score, a simple and geometry-based data-quality metric that evaluates utility by measuring alignment between a sample's gradients and a target direction induced by a pre-trained reference model. This leverages readily available model weights, avoids needing validation datasets, and incurs minimal computational overheads. Building on this metric, we propose Grad-Mimic, a two-stage framework that re-weights samples online to accelerate training and aggregates sample utilities offline to construct effective data filters. Empirically, we show that using mimic scores to guide training improves data efficiency, accelerates convergence, yields consistent performance gains across six image datasets, and enhances CLIP models with 20.7% fewer training steps. Additionally, mimic score-based filters augment existing filtering techniques, enabling improved CLIP models trained with 4.7 million fewer samples.

</details>


### [365] [CleanSurvival: Automated data preprocessing for time-to-event models using reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.03946)
*Yousef Koka,David Selby,Gerrit Großmann,Kathan Pandya,Sebastian Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CleanSurvival，一个基于强化学习（Q-learning）的生存分析数据预处理优化框架，能够自动选择插补、异常检测和特征提取的最佳组合，提升Cox、随机森林、神经网络等时间-事件模型的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据预处理在机器学习中常被忽视，自动化机器学习管道已逐步将预处理整合到分类和回归任务中，但对于生存分析这类针对删失数据的专门任务仍缺乏定制化的自动化解决方案。

Method: 基于Learn2Clean的Q-learning框架，针对生存分析扩展，处理连续和分类变量，自动选择数据插补、异常检测和特征提取技术的最优组合，支持Cox模型、随机森林、神经网络或用户自定义的时间-事件模型。

Result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，Q-learning预处理相比简单基线能提升预测性能；模拟研究证明在不同类型和水平的缺失与噪声下均有效；运行时行为具有条件依赖性。

Conclusion: CleanSurvival为生存分析提供了自动化预处理方案，使生存研究更快捷、结果更稳健，有助于将AutoML推广到更广泛的模型类型。

Abstract: Data preprocessing is often paid little attention in machine learning, despite its potentially significant impact on model performance. While automated machine learning pipelines are starting to recognize and integrate data preprocessing into their solutions for classification and regression tasks, this integration is lacking for more specialized tasks like time-to-event models for censored data. As a result, survival analysis not only faces the general challenges of data preprocessing but also suffers from the lack of tailored, automated solutions in this area. To address this gap, this paper presents CleanSurvival, a reinforcement-learning-based solution for optimizing preprocessing pipelines, extended specifically for survival analysis. The framework can handle continuous and categorical variables. It builds upon Learn2Clean's Q-learning to select which combination of data imputation, outlier detection and feature extraction techniques achieves optimal performance for a Cox, random forest, neural network or user-supplied time-to-event model. The Python package is available on GitHub: https://github.com/datasciapps/CleanSurvival. Experimental benchmarks on real-world datasets show that the Q-learning-based data preprocessing can improve predictive performance relative to simple baselines, while runtime behavior is condition-dependent and most clearly interpretable in the best-covered benchmark cells. Furthermore, a simulation study demonstrates effectiveness across different types and levels of missingness and noise. With an increase in the use of machine learning, it becomes important to generalise AutoML pipelines to a variety of models now present, including survival analysis. Tools like CleanSurvival, which integrate preprocessing for survival analysis, can make survival studies easier and quicker to perform, as well as make the results more robust.

</details>


### [366] [Intelligent Offloading in Vehicular Edge Computing: A Comprehensive Review of Deep Reinforcement Learning Approaches and Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06963)
*Ashab Uddin,Ahmed Hamdi Sakr,Ning Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了基于深度强化学习（DRL）的车辆边缘计算（VEC）任务卸载策略，从学习范式、系统架构和优化目标三个维度分类比较了现有工作，分析了MDP建模、奖励设计、协调机制和可扩展性等关键问题，并指出了未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能交通系统（ITS）日益复杂，传统计算卸载策略难以应对动态异构环境，需要探索强化学习/深度强化学习作为自适应决策框架。

Method: 采用综述方法，对DRL-based VEC卸载研究进行系统性分类与比较，分类维度包括学习范式（单智能体/多智能体）、系统架构（集中式/分布式/分层式）、优化目标（延迟/能耗/公平性），并分析MDP公式化应用及奖励设计、协调机制、可扩展性等趋势。

Result: 提供了DRL-based VEC卸载的全面分类体系，揭示了不同学习范式与架构的适用场景及权衡关系，总结了当前在奖励设计、协调机制和可扩展性方面的进展。

Conclusion: 指出当前仍存在开放性挑战，需要进一步发展鲁棒且智能的卸载策略以支撑下一代ITS。

Abstract: The increasing complexity of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) has led to significant interest in computational offloading to external infrastructures such as edge servers, vehicular nodes, and UAVs. These dynamic and heterogeneous environments pose challenges for traditional offloading strategies, prompting the exploration of Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) as adaptive decision-making frameworks. This survey presents a comprehensive review of recent advances in DRL-based offloading for vehicular edge computing (VEC). We classify and compare existing works based on learning paradigms (e.g., single-agent, multi-agent), system architectures (e.g., centralized, distributed, hierarchical), and optimization objectives (e.g., latency, energy, fairness). Furthermore, we analyze how Markov Decision Process (MDP) formulations are applied and highlight emerging trends in reward design, coordination mechanisms, and scalability. Finally, we identify open challenges and outline future research directions to guide the development of robust and intelligent offloading strategies for next-generation ITS.

</details>


### [367] [Yes, Q-learning Helps Offline In-Context RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.17666)
*Denis Tarasov,Alexander Nikulin,Ilya Zisman,Albina Klepach,Andrei Polubarov,Nikita Lyubaykin,Alexander Derevyagin,Igor Kiselev,Vladislav Kurenkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出在离线上下文强化学习（ICRL）中引入RL目标（而非仅用监督目标），在150+数据集上平均提升约30%性能，在XLand-MiniGrid环境中性能翻倍，并发现价值学习中的保守性约束能带来额外收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离线ICRL方法主要依赖监督训练目标，而监督目标在离线RL场景中存在局限性，因此需要探索将RL目标整合到离线ICRL框架中，以更好地对齐强化学习的奖励最大化目标。

Method: 在离线ICRL框架中引入RL目标（如策略梯度等），并在超过150个GridWorld和MuJoCo环境数据集上进行实验，同时加入价值学习中的保守性约束进行测试。

Result: 相比广泛采用的Algorithm Distillation (AD)，优化RL目标平均提升约30%性能；在XLand-MiniGrid环境中性能翻倍；添加保守性约束在几乎所有测试设置中带来额外改进。

Conclusion: 将ICRL的学习目标与RL的奖励最大化目标对齐至关重要，离线RL是推动ICRL发展的有前景方向。

Abstract: Existing offline in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) methods have predominantly relied on supervised training objectives, which are known to have limitations in offline RL settings. In this study, we explore the integration of RL objectives within an offline ICRL framework. Through experiments on more than 150 GridWorld and MuJoCo environment-derived datasets, we demonstrate that optimizing RL objectives directly improves performance by approximately 30% on average compared to widely adopted Algorithm Distillation (AD), across various dataset coverages, structures, expertise levels, and environmental complexities. Furthermore, in the challenging XLand-MiniGrid environment, RL objectives doubled the performance of AD. Our results also reveal that the addition of conservatism during value learning brings additional improvements in almost all settings tested. Our findings emphasize the importance of aligning ICRL learning objectives with the RL reward-maximization goal, and demonstrate that offline RL is a promising direction for advancing ICRL.

</details>


### [368] [An uncertainty-aware Bayesian framework for machine learning classification models: A case study in land cover classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.21510)
*Samuel Bilson,Miles McCrory,Anna Pustogvar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯二次判别分析（BQDA）框架，在生成式ML分类模型中显式建模输入测量不确定性，并将其应用于哥白尼哨兵-2土地利用覆盖数据集。实验表明，相比随机森林和神经网络等方法，BQDA在保持预测性能的同时更具可解释性、计算效率更高，且能显式处理测量不确定性，提升了模型的可信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前机器学习分类模型的不确定性量化研究主要关注认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty），而忽视了输入测量不确定性（input measurement uncertainty），后者对于计量学（metrology）中的可追溯性至关重要。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出能够同时考虑输入测量不确定性的贝叶斯生成式分类框架。

Method: 提出一个贝叶斯框架用于生成式ML分类模型，具体采用贝叶斯二次判别分析（BQDA）模型，并将其应用于2020和2021年哥白尼哨兵-2的土地利用覆盖计量数据集。通过与随机森林和神经网络等流行分类模型进行基准对比，并在合成分类数据上改变输入测量噪声的分布类型和强度进行模拟验证，以评估模型的泛化能力。

Result: 在真实数据和合成数据上，BQDA模型均表现出更高的可信度：更具可解释性、显式建模了输入测量不确定性、在不同领域和规模的数据集上保持了类别概率输出的预测性能，同时计算效率更高。

Conclusion: BQDA模型作为一种能显式处理输入测量不确定性的生成式分类方法，在可信度、可解释性和计算效率方面优于流行的黑盒模型（如随机森林和神经网络），适用于对计量可追溯性要求高的应用场景。

Abstract: Ensuring that predictions of machine learning (ML) classification models are accompanied by uncertainty estimates is one of the main pillars of trustworthy AI. Current research in uncertainty quantification focuses mainly on epistemic uncertainty of the ML model, but rarely takes account of input measurement uncertainty, which is vital for traceability in metrology. In this work we propose a Bayesian framework for generative ML classification models that takes account of input measurement uncertainty. We take the specific case of a Bayesian quadratic discriminant analysis (BQDA) model, and apply it to metrological land cover datasets from Copernicus Sentinel-2 from 2020 and 2021. We benchmark the performance of the model against more popular classification models used in land cover maps such as random forests and neural networks. To validate and assess the generalisability of such a model, we also run simulations over synthetic classification data, varying distribution type and strength of the input measurement noise. We find for both real and synthetic data, the BQDA model presented is more trustworthy, in the sense that it is more interpretable, explicitly models the input measurement uncertainty, and maintains predictive performance of class probability outputs across datasets over different domains and sizes, whilst also being more computationally efficient.

</details>


### [369] [Generating realistic global precipitation fields from modelled atmospheric circulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.00307)
*Michael Aich,Sebastian Bathiany,Philipp Hess,Yu Huang,Niklas Boers*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于条件扩散模型和UNet架构的生成式机器学习方法，从少量大气变量生成高分辨率（0.25°）全球日降水场，作为地球系统模型中传统参数化方案的替代，能高效生成集合预测并减少降水偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球系统模型中的降水参数化方案存在计算成本高、忽略位置间相互作用、难以捕捉精细尺度降水过程以及引入显著偏差等问题，亟需一种更高效、准确的替代方案。

Method: 基于条件扩散模型与UNet架构，以少量全球预报大气变量为条件，生成0.25°分辨率的高精度全球日降水场；在ERA5再分析数据上训练，并设计方法使其可迁移至未见过的地球系统模型数据。

Result: 该方法能高效生成集合预测以捕捉降水不确定性，无需人工调参；在保持与ESM大尺度（年）趋势一致的同时，有效缓解了ESM降水中的偏差；以远低于动力模型的计算成本获得高分辨率降水。

Conclusion: 复杂的降水模式可以直接从大尺度大气变量中学习得到，该生成式方法为传统参数化方案提供了计算高效的替代方案，可在不运行高分辨率动力模型的情况下获得高分辨率降水。

Abstract: Improving the representation of precipitation in Earth system models (ESMs) is critical for assessing the impacts of climate change and especially of extreme events like floods and droughts. In existing ESMs, precipitation is not resolved explicitly, but represented by parameterizations. These typically rely on resolving approximated but computationally expensive column-based physics, not accounting for interactions between locations. They struggle to capture fine-scale precipitation processes and introduce significant biases. We present a novel approach, based on generative machine learning, which integrates a conditional diffusion model with a UNet architecture to generate accurate, high-resolution (0.25°) global daily precipitation fields from a small set of prognostic atmospheric variables. Unlike traditional parameterizations, our framework efficiently produces ensemble predictions, capturing uncertainties in precipitation, and does not require fine-tuning by hand. We train our model on the ERA5 reanalysis and present a method that allows us to apply it to unseen ESM data, enabling fast generation of probabilistic forecasts and climate scenarios. By leveraging interactions between global prognostic variables, our approach provides an alternative parameterization scheme that mitigates biases present in the ESM precipitation while maintaining consistency with its large-scale (annual) trends. This work demonstrates that complex precipitation patterns can be learned directly from large-scale atmospheric variables, offering a computationally efficient method to obtain high-resolution precipitation without the cost of running the dynamical model at such high resolution.

</details>


### [370] [PLAID: A Unified Data Model for Machine Learning on Heterogeneous Physics Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.02974)
*Fabien Casenave,Xavier Roynard,Brian Staber,Alexandre Devaux-Rivière,William Piat,Michele Alessandro Bucci,Nissrine Akkari,Abbas Kabalan,Xuan Minh Vuong Nguyen,Luca Saverio,Raphaël Carpintero Perez,Anthony Kalaydjian,Samy Fouché,Thierry Gonon,Ghassan Najjar,Thomas Daniel,Emmanuel Menier,Matthieu Nastorg,Giovanni Catalani,Christian Rey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PLAID是一个统一的、可扩展的数据层，用于异构物理仿真，能够保留仿真数据的完整复杂性并支持高效的机器学习工作流。论文发布了六个覆盖结构力学和计算流体力学的标准化数据集，并集成了可复现的评估协议和Hugging Face平台，以推动社区驱动的开放基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于机器学习的代理模型因缺乏大规模、多样化、标准化的物理仿真数据集而受限；现有基准测试往往聚焦于狭窄领域或简化数据模型，无法捕捉真实场景中几何、网格和拓扑的异构性，难以评估模型的泛化能力。

Method: 提出PLAID统一可扩展数据层，保留异构仿真数据的完整复杂性；配套数据集构建与操作库（PLAID lib）；发布六个涵盖结构力学和计算流体力学的标准化数据集；集成Hugging Face平台，提供可复现的评估协议并支持社区驱动的开放基准测试。

Result: 发布了六个标准化数据集，覆盖结构力学和计算流体动力学领域，反映真实工业场景；提供了PLAID数据层及配套库；建立了可复现的评估协议和社区基准测试平台。

Conclusion: PLAID通过统一的数据层和标准化基准数据集，有效解决了物理仿真机器学习中数据多样性和泛化评估的挑战，为推动该领域的社区协作和可复现研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: Machine learning-based surrogate models have emerged as a powerful tool to accelerate simulation-driven scientific workflows, but their adoption is limited by the lack of large-scale, diverse, and standardized datasets for physics-based simulations. Existing benchmarks often focus on narrow domains or rely on simplified data models, and fail to capture the heterogeneity arising from variable geometries, meshes, and topologies, which is critical for assessing generalization in realistic settings. We introduce PLAID (Physics-Learning AI Data model), a unified and extensible data layer for heterogeneous physics simulations. It preserves the full complexity of simulation data while enabling efficient and scalable machine learning workflows, together with a library for dataset construction and manipulation~(\href{https://github.com/PLAID-lib/plaid}{github.com/PLAID-lib/plaid}). We release six datasets covering structural mechanics and computational fluid dynamics, designed to reflect realistic industrial scenarios and provide standardized benchmarks. The framework includes reproducible evaluation protocols and is integrated with Hugging Face to enable open, community-driven benchmarking with active user participation (\href{https://huggingface.co/PLAIDcompetitions}{huggingface.co/PLAIDcompetitions}).

</details>


### [371] [Beyond Semantics: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Reasonless Intermediate Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13775)
*Karthik Valmeekam,Vardhan Palod,Kaya Stechly,Atharva Gundawar,Subbarao Kambhampati*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过在形式可验证推理轨迹上从头训练Transformer模型，发现模型即使使用完全正确的推理轨迹训练，仍可能产生无效推理但得到正确答案；更关键的是，使用完全打乱、与问题无关的损坏轨迹训练的模型与使用正确轨迹训练的模型表现相当，甚至在分布外任务上泛化更好。GRPO强化学习后训练虽提升答案准确率但未改善轨迹有效性，且推理轨迹长度与问题计算复杂度无关。这些结果挑战了CoT反映或诱导可预测推理行为的假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究对CoT的作用存在争议：一些工作赋予其语义解释，另一些则警告不应将其视为模型内部计算过程的透明忠实代理。作者旨在系统性地探究推导轨迹的端用户语义在模型性能中的实际作用。

Method: 在形式可验证的推理轨迹上从头训练Transformer模型，设置对照实验：(1) 完全正确的推理轨迹 vs. 仅答案基线；(2) 完全损坏（中间步骤与问题无关）的轨迹 vs. 正确轨迹；(3) 基于GRPO的强化学习后训练对轨迹有效性的影响；(4) 推理轨迹长度与问题计算复杂度的关系。

Result: (1) 正确轨迹训练优于仅答案基线，但模型仍可生成无效推理却得到正确答案；(2) 损坏轨迹训练的模型与正确轨迹训练的模型性能相当，且在分布外任务上泛化更好；(3) GRPO后训练提升答案准确率但未改善轨迹有效性；(4) 推理轨迹长度与问题计算复杂度基本无关。

Conclusion: 中间token或Chain of Thought并不反映或诱导可预测的推理行为，应警惕对模型输出进行拟人化或过度解读，尽管其表面形式看似具有推理过程。

Abstract: Recent impressive results from large reasoning models have been interpreted as a triumph of Chain of Thought (CoT), and especially of the process of training on CoTs sampled from base LLMs in order to help find new reasoning patterns. While these traces certainly seem to help model performance, it is not clear how they influence it, with some works ascribing semantics to them and others cautioning against relying on them as transparent and faithful proxies of the model's internal computational process. To systematically investigate the role of end-user semantics of derivational traces, we set up a controlled study where we train transformer models from scratch on formally verifiable reasoning traces and the solutions they lead to. We notice that, despite gains over the solution-only baseline, models trained on entirely correct traces can still produce invalid reasoning traces even when arriving at correct solutions. More interestingly, our experiments also show that models trained on corrupted traces, whose intermediate reasoning steps bear no relation to the problem they accompany, perform similarly to those trained on correct ones, and even generalize better on out-of-distribution tasks. We also study the effect of GRPO-based RL post-training on trace validity, noting that while solution accuracy increases, this is not accompanied by improvements in trace validity. Finally, we examine whether reasoning-trace length reflects inference-time scaling and find that trace length is largely agnostic to the underlying computational complexity of the problem being solved. These results challenge the assumption that intermediate tokens or ``Chains of Thought'' reflect or induce predictable reasoning behaviors and caution against anthropomorphizing such outputs or over-interpreting them (despite their mostly seemingly forms) as evidence of human-like or algorithmic behaviors in language models.

</details>


### [372] [OCR-Reasoning Benchmark: Unveiling the True Capabilities of MLLMs in Complex Text-Rich Image Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17163)
*Mingxin Huang,Yongxin Shi,Dezhi Peng,Songxuan Lai,Zecheng Xie,Lianwen Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OCR-Reasoning基准，包含1,069个带逐步推理过程的人工标注样本，用于系统评估多模态大模型在文本丰富图像上的推理能力。实验表明最先进的MLLM在该基准上准确率均低于50%，揭示文本丰富图像推理任务仍是亟待解决的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态慢思考系统在视觉推理任务上表现优异，但在文本丰富图像推理任务上的能力尚未被充分研究，缺乏专门且系统化的基准测试。

Method: 构建OCR-Reasoning基准，包含1,069个人工标注样本，覆盖6种核心推理能力和18种实用推理任务；不仅提供最终答案，还提供逐步推理过程的双重标注，以支持对模型最终答案和推理过程的全面评估。

Result: 对最新MLLMs的全面评估显示，即使最先进的模型准确率也均未超过50%，表明文本丰富图像推理任务存在显著困难。

Conclusion: 文本丰富图像推理是一个亟待解决的紧迫问题，现有MLLMs在该领域能力严重不足。

Abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal slow-thinking systems have demonstrated remarkable performance across various visual reasoning tasks. However, their capabilities in text-rich image reasoning tasks remain understudied due to the absence of a dedicated and systematic benchmark. To address this gap, we propose OCR-Reasoning, a novel benchmark designed to systematically assess Multimodal Large Language Models on text-rich image reasoning tasks. Specifically, OCR-Reasoning comprises 1,069 human-annotated examples spanning 6 core reasoning abilities and 18 practical reasoning tasks in text-rich visual scenarios. Unlike existing text-rich image understanding benchmarks that only provide a final answer, this benchmark additionally provides a detailed step-by-step reasoning process. This dual annotation enables the evaluation of both the models' final answers and their reasoning processes, thereby offering a holistic assessment of text-rich reasoning capabilities. By leveraging this benchmark, we conducted a comprehensive evaluation of the latest MLLMs. Our results demonstrate that even the most advanced MLLMs exhibit substantial difficulties in text-rich image reasoning tasks, with none achieving an accuracy above 50\% on our benchmark, indicating that the challenges of text-rich image reasoning are an urgent issue to be addressed. The benchmark and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/OCR-Reasoning.

</details>


### [373] [Message-Passing State-Space Models: Improving Graph Learning with Modern Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18728)
*Andrea Ceni,Alessio Gravina,Claudio Gallicchio,Davide Bacciu,Carola-Bibiane Schonlieb,Moshe Eliasof*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MP-SSM，将状态空间模型（SSM）的计算原理嵌入消息传递神经网络（MPNN）框架中，实现一种既能进行高效长程信息传播、保持排列等变性和消息传递简洁性，又能精确分析信息流（如梯度消失和过挤压问题）的统一方法，适用于静态图和时序图，在多个任务上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图状态空间模型（GSSMs）通过将SSM模块应用于从图中提取的序列来操作，但这种方式往往损害了排列等变性、消息传递兼容性和计算效率等核心性质，需要一种更好的融合方式。

Method: 将现代SSM计算的核心原理直接嵌入消息传递神经网络（MPNN）框架中，提出MP-SSM。该方法在保持消息传递架构简洁性的同时，实现了高效、排列等变的长程信息传播。设计上允许精确的敏感性分析，从理论上刻画深层网络中的信息流、梯度消失和过挤压问题，并支持类似现代SSM的高度优化并行实现。

Result: 在节点分类、图属性预测、长程基准测试和时空预测等多种任务上验证了MP-SSM的通用性和强大的实证性能。

Conclusion: MP-SSM成功地将SSM与消息传递框架统一，解决了现有GSSMs在等变性、效率和兼容性方面的缺陷，同时提供了精确的理论分析工具和高效并行实现，为静态和时序图学习提供了新的方法论。

Abstract: The recent success of State-Space Models (SSMs) in sequence modeling has motivated their adaptation to graph learning, giving rise to Graph State-Space Models (GSSMs). However, existing GSSMs operate by applying SSM modules to sequences extracted from graphs, often compromising core properties such as permutation equivariance, message-passing compatibility, and computational efficiency. In this paper, we introduce a new perspective by embedding the key principles of modern SSM computation directly into the Message-Passing Neural Network framework, resulting in a unified methodology for both static and temporal graphs. Our approach, MP-SSM, enables efficient, permutation-equivariant, and long-range information propagation while preserving the architectural simplicity of message passing. Crucially, MP-SSM enables an exact sensitivity analysis, which we use to theoretically characterize information flow and evaluate issues like vanishing gradients and over-squashing in the deep regime. Furthermore, our design choices allow for a highly optimized parallel implementation akin to modern SSMs. We validate MP-SSM across a wide range of tasks, including node classification, graph property prediction, long-range benchmarks, and spatiotemporal forecasting, demonstrating both its versatility and strong empirical performance.

</details>


### [374] [Learnable Kernel Density Estimation for Graphs and Its Application to Graph-Level Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.21285)
*Xudong Wang,Ziheng Sun,Chris Ding,Jicong Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LGKDE框架，利用图神经网络和最大均值差异学习图核密度估计，通过扰动节点特征和图谱来优化密度估计，在理论和实验上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于图核和核密度估计的图密度估计方法由于使用手工设计的固定特征而性能不佳，需要一种能同时捕捉图结构模式和语义变化且具有理论保证的方法。

Method: LGKDE使用图神经网络将每个图表示为离散分布，利用最大均值差异学习多尺度KDE的图度量；通过扰动节点特征和图谱来生成对比样本，最大化密度相对于扰动版本的密度来学习所有参数。

Result: 在合成图分布密度恢复和多个基准数据集上的图异常检测任务中，LGKDE相比最先进基线方法表现出优越性能。

Conclusion: LGKDE在理论和实验上均有效，具有一致性、收敛性、鲁棒性和泛化性保证，为图密度估计提供了新的有效范式。

Abstract: This work proposes a framework LGKDE that learns kernel density estimation for graphs. The key challenge in graph density estimation lies in effectively capturing both structural patterns and semantic variations while maintaining theoretical guarantees. Combining graph kernels and kernel density estimation (KDE) is a standard approach to graph density estimation, but has unsatisfactory performance due to the handcrafted and fixed features of kernels. Our method LGKDE leverages graph neural networks to represent each graph as a discrete distribution and utilizes maximum mean discrepancy to learn the graph metric for multi-scale KDE, where all parameters are learned by maximizing the density of graphs relative to the density of their well-designed perturbed counterparts. The perturbations are conducted on both node features and graph spectra, which helps better characterize the boundary of normal density regions. Theoretically, we establish consistency and convergence guarantees for LGKDE, including bounds on the mean integrated squared error, robustness, and generalization. We validate LGKDE by demonstrating its effectiveness in recovering the underlying density of synthetic graph distributions and applying it to graph anomaly detection across diverse benchmark datasets. Extensive empirical evaluation shows that LGKDE demonstrates superior performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines on most benchmark datasets.

</details>


### [375] [Muddit: Liberating Generation Beyond Text-to-Image with a Unified Discrete Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23606)
*Qingyu Shi,Jinbin Bai,Zhuoran Zhao,Wenhao Chai,Kaidong Yu,Jianzong Wu,Yunhai Tong,Xiangtai Li,Xuelong Li,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了Meissonic: Muddit，一个统一的离散扩散Transformer模型，通过将预训练文本到图像骨干网络的强视觉先验与轻量级文本解码器相结合，实现了跨文本和图像模态的快速并行生成，在质量和效率上媲美或超越更大的自回归模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的统一生成模型存在两大问题：自回归模型因顺序解码导致推理速度慢，非自回归模型因预训练骨干网络受限而泛化能力弱。本文旨在解决上述矛盾，实现既快速又具备强泛化能力的统一多模态生成。

Method: Muddit是一个统一的离散扩散Transformer，它没有从头训练，而是将预训练的文本到图像骨干网络（强视觉先验）与一个轻量级文本解码器进行集成，在统一架构下支持灵活的跨模态生成。

Result: 实验结果表明，Muddit在质量和效率上均达到或超越了显著更大的自回归模型。

Conclusion: 这项工作展示了纯离散扩散模型在配备强视觉先验后，能够成为可扩展且高效统一生成骨干网络，凸显了其在统一多模态生成中的潜力。

Abstract: Unified generation models aim to handle diverse tasks across modalities -- such as text generation, image generation, and vision-language reasoning -- within a single architecture and decoding paradigm. Autoregressive unified models suffer from slow inference due to sequential decoding, and non-autoregressive unified models suffer from weak generalization due to limited pretrained backbones. We introduce the second-generation Meissonic: Muddit, a unified discrete diffusion transformer that enables fast and parallel generation across both text and image modalities. Unlike prior unified diffusion models trained from scratch, Muddit integrates strong visual priors from a pretrained text-to-image backbone with a lightweight text decoder, enabling flexible and high-quality multimodal generation under a unified architecture. Empirical results show that Muddit achieves competitive or superior performance compared to significantly larger autoregressive models in both quality and efficiency. The work highlights the potential of purely discrete diffusion, when equipped with strong visual priors, as a scalable and effective backbone for unified generation.

</details>


### [376] [Efficient Prediction of SO(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Matrices via SO(2) Local Frames](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09398)
*Haiyang Yu,Yuchao Lin,Xuan Zhang,Xiaofeng Qian,Shuiwang Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出QHNetV2，通过SO(2)局部框架实现全局SO(3)等变性，消除昂贵的SO(3) Clebsch-Gordan张量积，在QH9和MD17数据集上取得优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测哈密顿矩阵以加速电子结构计算，现有SO(3)等变网络依赖昂贵的Clebsch-Gordan张量积，计算效率低。

Method: 利用哈密顿矩阵非对角块与SO(2)局部框架的固有关系，在SO(2)局部框架内执行所有非对角特征更新和消息传递，引入连续的SO(2)张量积融合节点特征，无需SO(3)张量积即可实现全局SO(3)等变性。

Result: 在QH9和MD17大规模数据集上，模型在多种分子结构和轨迹上均达到优越性能，展现出强泛化能力。

Conclusion: 基于SO(2)局部框架的SO(2)操作为可扩展且对称感知的电子结构学习提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: We consider the task of predicting Hamiltonian matrices to accelerate electronic structure calculations, which plays an important role in physics, chemistry, and materials science. Motivated by the inherent relationship between the off-diagonal blocks of the Hamiltonian matrix and the SO(2) local frame, we propose a novel and efficient network, called QHNetV2, that achieves global SO(3) equivariance without the costly SO(3) Clebsch-Gordan tensor products. This is achieved by introducing a set of new efficient and powerful SO(2)-equivariant operations and performing all off-diagonal feature updates and message passing within SO(2) local frames, thereby eliminating the need of SO(3) tensor products. Moreover, a continuous SO(2) tensor product is performed within the SO(2) local frame at each node to fuse node features, mimicking the symmetric contraction operation. Extensive experiments on the large QH9 and MD17 datasets demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance across a wide range of molecular structures and trajectories, highlighting its strong generalization capability. The proposed SO(2) operations on SO(2) local frames offer a promising direction for scalable and symmetry-aware learning of electronic structures. Our code will be released as part of the AIRS library https://github.com/divelab/AIRS.

</details>


### [377] [Athena: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning with Data-efficient Process Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09532)
*Shuai Wang,Zhenhua Liu,Jiaheng Wei,Xuanwu Yin,Dong Li,Emad Barsoum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Athena-PRM，一种多模态过程奖励模型，通过利用弱/强补全者之间的预测一致性作为标准来高效生成高质量过程标注数据，仅需5000样本即可在多种场景下实现卓越性能，并在多个基准上取得SOTA结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统过程奖励模型（PRM）开发需要大量时间与资金投入进行步骤级标注，而现有的自动标注方法（如蒙特卡洛估计）会产生噪声标签且计算成本高昂。本文旨在高效生成高质量过程标注数据，降低PRM训练成本。

Method: 1）提出利用弱补全者与强补全者之间的预测一致性作为标准，识别可靠的过程标签；2）提出两种有效策略提升PRM性能：ORM初始化（结果奖励模型初始化）和负数据上采样；3）仅用5000样本训练Athena-PRM。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B作为策略模型时，Athena-PRM在测试时扩展场景下使WeMath提升10.2分、MathVista提升7.1分；在VisualProcessBench上超越先前SOTA 3.9 F1-score；作为奖励模型进行奖励排名微调后，Athena-7B在五个基准上显著超越基线。

Conclusion: Athena-PRM在测试时扩展、推理步骤正确性评估和奖励排名微调三种场景中均展现出优越性能，证明了所提出的高效标注方法和训练策略的有效性。

Abstract: We present Athena-PRM, a multimodal process reward model (PRM) designed to evaluate the reward score for each step in solving complex reasoning problems. Developing high-performance PRMs typically demands significant time and financial investment, primarily due to the necessity for step-level annotations of reasoning steps. Conventional automated labeling methods, such as Monte Carlo estimation, often produce noisy labels and incur substantial computational costs. To efficiently generate high-quality process-labeled data, we propose leveraging prediction consistency between weak and strong completers as a criterion for identifying reliable process labels. Remarkably, Athena-PRM demonstrates outstanding effectiveness across various scenarios and benchmarks with just 5,000 samples. Furthermore, we also develop two effective strategies to improve the performance of PRMs: ORM initialization and up-sampling for negative data. We validate our approach in three specific scenarios: verification for test time scaling, direct evaluation of reasoning step correctness, and reward ranked fine-tuning. Our Athena-PRM consistently achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks and scenarios. Notably, when using Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the policy model, Athena-PRM enhances performance by 10.2 points on WeMath and 7.1 points on MathVista for test time scaling. Furthermore, Athena-PRM sets the state-of-the-art (SoTA) results in VisualProcessBench and outperforms the previous SoTA by 3.9 F1-score, showcasing its robust capability to accurately assess the correctness of the reasoning step. Additionally, utilizing Athena-PRM as the reward model, we develop Athena-7B with reward ranked fine-tuning and outperforms baseline with a significant margin on five benchmarks.

</details>


### [378] [Interpretability and Generalization Bounds for Learning Spatial Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.15199)
*Alejandro Francisco Queiruga,Theo Gutman-Solo,Shuai Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过数值分析技术严格量化了机器学习模型在求解线性微分方程时的准确性、收敛速度和泛化边界，发现数据函数空间对模型泛化至关重要，不同模型可能表现相反的泛化行为，并提出了基于格林函数的新可解释性方法和交叉验证技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管机器学习在科学问题中有许多看似有前景的应用，但视觉结果可能具有欺骗性，需要严格量化ML模型在科学计算中的真实性能。

Method: 采用数值分析技术量化ML模型在求解线性微分方程时的准确性、收敛率和泛化边界；通过实验证明常用模型（包括物理专用技术）的泛化不足；从理论分析出发，提出从黑箱模型权重中提取格林函数表示的机械可解释性方法。

Result: 发现数据函数空间（而非仅数据数量和离散化方式）对模型泛化至关重要；不同类别模型可能表现出相反的泛化行为；成功从黑箱模型权重中提取格林函数表示。

Conclusion: 研究结果提出了一种用于衡量物理系统泛化能力的新交叉验证技术，可作为基准方法。

Abstract: While there are many applications of ML to scientific problems that look promising, visuals can be deceiving. Using numerical analysis techniques, we rigorously quantify the accuracy, convergence rates, and generalization bounds of certain ML models applied to linear differential equations for parameter discovery or solution finding. Beyond the quantity and discretization of data, we identify that the function space of the data is critical to the generalization of the model. A similar lack of generalization is empirically demonstrated for commonly used models, including physics-specific techniques. Counterintuitively, we find that different classes of models can exhibit opposing generalization behaviors. Based on our theoretical analysis, we also introduce a new mechanistic interpretability lens on scientific models whereby Green's function representations can be extracted from the weights of black-box models. Our results inform a new cross-validation technique for measuring generalization in physical systems, which can serve as a benchmark.

</details>


### [379] [Real-Time Progress Prediction in Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23274)
*Hans Peter Lyngsøe Raaschou-Jensen,Constanza Fierro,Anders Søgaard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究推理语言模型在长链思维过程中的实时进度预测问题。通过离散化推理轨迹训练线性探针分类状态，并微调模型生成0-100%的进度估计，最优模型在数学推理轨迹上达到0.161 MAE。同时量化了进度标签的内在模糊性，发现Qwen3-4B模型的延续生成具有最小的展开离散度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长链思维推理模型在复杂智能体任务中表现出色，但其内部进度对用户不透明，导致期望管理和实时监督困难。因此需要研究实时进度预测的可行性。

Method: 1) 离散化推理轨迹，训练线性探针对推理状态进行分类；2) 微调模型在链式思维推理过程中生成0-100%的进度估计；3) 通过测量部分展开轨迹中隐含进度值的变化，量化进度标签的内在模糊性。

Result: 最强进度报告检查点在数学推理轨迹上达到0.161 MAE，优于位置基线。Qwen3-4B的延续生成产生最小的展开离散度，进度标签最稳定。

Conclusion: 实时进度预测对长链推理模型是可行的；较大模型通过减少剩余解决方案长度的变化，可以使进度标签更稳定。

Abstract: Recent reasoning language models, particularly those that employ long latent chains of thought, achieve strong performance on complex agentic tasks. However, as these models operate over increasingly long time horizons, their internal progress becomes opaque to users, making expectation management and real-time oversight difficult. In this work, we investigate whether real-time progress prediction is feasible for such models. We first test whether hidden states encode progress information by discretizing reasoning trajectories and training a linear probe to classify reasoning states. We then fine-tune models to generate progress estimates from 0--100\% during chain-of-thought reasoning. Our strongest progress-reporting checkpoint reaches 0.161 MAE on mathematical reasoning traces and outperforms position baselines in this setting. Finally, we quantify the intrinsic ambiguity of progress labels by measuring how much the implied progress value varies from the same partial rollout. This ambiguity is lowest for Qwen3-4B, whose continuations produce the smallest rollout dispersion, suggesting that larger models can make progress labels more stable by reducing variation in remaining solution length.

</details>


### [380] [Exploring the robustness of TractOracle methods in RL-based tractography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.11486)
*Jeremi Levesque,Antoine Théberge,Maxime Descoteaux,Pierre-Marc Jodoin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在TractOracle-RL框架基础上整合了强化学习的最新进展，提出了四种扩展方法，并引入了一种名为迭代奖励训练（IRT）的新方案。实验表明，结合oracle的RL方法在多个数据集上显著优于传统纤维追踪技术，在准确性和解剖有效性方面表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统纤维追踪算法存在假阳性问题，TractOracle-RL通过解剖先验奖励机制有所改善，但其框架仍有进一步优化的空间。作者希望整合RL领域的最新进展来提升追踪性能，并探索更高效的训练范式。

Method: 1) 在TractOracle-RL基础上提出了四种扩展方法，整合了RL领域的最新进展；2) 提出IRT训练方案，受RLHF启发，利用束过滤方法迭代优化oracle的引导信号，替代人工反馈；3) 在五个不同的dMRI数据集上进行评估。

Result: 结合oracle的RL方法在所有数据集上均表现出稳健可靠的追踪效果，显著优于传统方法；IRT方案有效提升了训练的准确性；四种扩展方法均保持了oracle带来的性能增益，不受具体方法或数据集影响。

Conclusion: 将oracle与RL框架结合是实现稳健可靠纤维追踪的关键因素，IRT作为一种无需人工标注的迭代训练范式具有良好前景。未来可将该方法推广至更多RL变体及临床数据集。

Abstract: Tractography algorithms leverage diffusion MRI to reconstruct the fibrous architecture of the brain's white matter. Among machine learning approaches, reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising framework for tractography, outperforming traditional methods in several key aspects. TractOracle-RL, a recent RL-based approach, reduces false positives by incorporating anatomical priors into the training process via a reward-based mechanism. In this paper, we investigate four extensions of the original TractOracle-RL framework by integrating recent advances in RL, and we evaluate their performance across five diverse diffusion MRI datasets. Results demonstrate that combining an oracle with the RL framework consistently leads to robust and reliable tractography, regardless of the specific method or dataset used. We also introduce a novel RL training scheme called Iterative Reward Training (IRT), inspired by the Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) paradigm. Instead of relying on human input, IRT leverages bundle filtering methods to iteratively refine the oracle's guidance throughout training. Experimental results show that RL methods trained with oracle feedback significantly outperform widely used tractography techniques in terms of accuracy and anatomical validity.

</details>


### [381] [MolPIF: A Parameter Interpolation Flow Model for Molecule Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.13762)
*Yaowei Jin,Junjie Wang,Yufan Tang,Wenkai Xiang,Duanhua Cao,Dan Teng,Zhehuan Fan,Jiacheng Xiong,Xia Sheng,Chuanlong Zeng,Duo An,Mingyue Zheng,Shuangjia Zheng,Qian Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MolPIF提出了一种参数插值流机制，通过统一连续坐标和离散原子类型的生成，在参数空间中建立Wasserstein-2最优传输和Fisher-Rao测地线，显著提升了SBDD的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度生成模型（如扩散模型和流匹配模型）难以统一连续原子坐标和离散原子类型这两种异质模态，缺乏一致的框架来捕捉蛋白质-配体复合物的几何和化学结构。

Method: 提出参数插值流机制MolPIF，在参数空间而不是样本空间进行分布插值，理论上恢复连续坐标的Wasserstein-2最优传输和离散原子类型的Fisher-Rao测地线，并引入几何增强学习策略。

Result: 在CrossDocked2020数据集上，MolPIF在结合亲和力、化学有效性、几何保真度和化学空间覆盖度方面均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: MolPIF在先导优化中展现出多功能性，支持灵活的先验分布选择（如Laplace分布），为SBDD建立了鲁棒的范式。

Abstract: Motivation: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) has advanced with deep generative models, but bridging the gap between continuous atomic coordinates and discrete atom types remains a challenge. Current approaches, such as diffusion and flow matching models, often fail to unify these heterogeneous modalities, relying on separate strategies or ill-fitting Euclidean metrics for discrete variables. This lack of a consistent framework limits generative models' ability to capture the geometric and chemical structure of protein-ligand complexes. Results: We present MolPIF, a parameter interpolation flow mechanism designed to unify the generation of continuous and discrete molecular variables. Unlike traditional flow models that operate in sample space, MolPIF interpolates between distributions in the parameter space, theoretically recovering Wasserstein-2 optimal transport for continuous coordinates and establishing Fisher-Rao geodesics for discrete atom types. We further incorporate a geometry-enhanced learning strategy to improve the capture of atomic contexts. Extensive evaluations on the CrossDocked2020 dataset demonstrate that MolPIF outperforms baselines in binding affinity, chemical validity, geometric fidelity and chemical space coverage. Additionally, MolPIF exhibits versatility in lead optimization and offers flexible prior distribution selection (such as Laplace), establishing a robust paradigm for SBDD. Availability: Source code is freely available at https://github.com/BLEACH366/MolPIF. Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics.

</details>


### [382] [A Physics-Informed Hierarchical Neural Network for Microwave Scattering Analysis of 3D PEC Targets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.03774)
*Rui Zhu,Yuexing Peng,George C. Alexandropoulos,Wenbo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种U型物理信息人工神经网络（U-PINet），用于三维PEC目标的微波散射分析。该网络结合近场图编码器和八叉树分层多尺度融合模块，基于电场积分方程残差训练，无需参考电流标签。在重复查询场景下，U-PINet优于物理信息基线方法，且相比传统MLFMA求解器大幅节省计算时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统矩量法和MLFMA在重复查询（多入射角或多频率）场景下计算成本高昂，而纯数据驱动代理模型对几何复杂目标的精度不足，因此需要一种兼顾物理保真度和计算效率的新方法。

Method: 提出U-PINet，结构包括：(1) 近场图编码器（使用可学习单变量基函数参数化）；(2) 基于八叉树组织的分层多尺度融合模块（U型结构）。网络训练目标为表面配置点上电场积分方程的离散残差，无需参考电流标签。

Result: 在典型和几何复杂的3D PEC目标上，针对多种频率和极化配置进行双站RCS重建评估，U-PINet优于代表性物理信息基线方法，并在重复查询场景下相比经典MLFMA求解器实现显著的计算时间节省。

Conclusion: U-PINet成功融合了MLFMA的物理分解思想与深度学习架构，在保持物理精度的同时大幅降低重复查询场景的计算成本，为计算电磁学中的高效散射建模提供了新途径。

Abstract: Accurate modeling of scattering from three-dimensional (3D) perfectly electrically conducting (PEC) targets at microwave frequencies constitutes a fundamental objective in computational electromagnetics, particularly for radar cross section (RCS) prediction and microwave scattering analysis. Classical solvers, such as the method of moments and the Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm (MLFMA), although provide high physical fidelity, they become costly under scenarios of repeated queries involving many incidence configurations or frequencies, whereas purely data-driven surrogates often lack accuracy on geometrically complex targets. This paper proposes a U-shaped physics-informed artificial neural network (U-PINet) for 3D microwave scattering analysis. Inspired by the near-far field decomposition of MLFMA, U-PINet combines a near-field graph encoder, parameterized by learnable univariate basis functions, with a hierarchical multi-scale fusion module organized on an octree partition. The proposed network is trained against a discretized residual of the electric-field integral equation at surface collocation points, without requiring reference current labels. Experiments on canonical and geometrically complex 3D PEC targets, conducted under multiple frequency and polarization configurations and assessed through bistatic RCS reconstruction, showcase that U-PINet outperforms representative physics-informed baselines, and yields substantial runtime savings over the classical MLFMA solver under repeated-query scenarios.

</details>


### [383] [A Unified Framework for Diffusion Model Unlearning with f-Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21167)
*Nicola Novello,Federico Fontana,Luigi Cinque,Deniz Gunduz,Andrea M. Tonello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于 $f$-散度的统一框架，将文本到图像扩散模型中的概念遗忘目标从KL散度（MSE损失）推广到任意 $f$-散度，其中 $\alpha$-散度族可得到与MSE同等高效的闭式训练目标，其余散度则通过变分形式的极小极大目标实现。理论分析和实验表明，不同散度影响梯度大小和收敛性质，例如Hellinger散度在多个场景下优于MSE，该框架允许根据应用需求灵活选择最优散度以平衡遗忘效果与生成保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念遗忘方法大多使用MSE损失（等价于KL散度），缺乏对更广泛散度家族的探索和理论理解。本文旨在建立统一的理论框架，将遗忘目标推广到任意 $f$-散度，从而提供更灵活的选择空间和更好的性能控制。

Method: 1) 将MSE损失重新解释为KL散度下两个高斯分布之间的差异；2) 将目标推广到任意 $f$-散度，识别出 $\alpha$-散度族具有高斯闭式解，训练代价与MSE相当；3) 对无闭式解的 $f$-散度，基于变分公式提出极小极大优化目标；4) 理论分析不同散度对梯度幅值和收敛性质的影响。

Result: Hellinger散度（$\alpha=1/2$的 $\alpha$-散度的一种）在多个遗忘场景中一致优于传统的MSE（KL散度）方法。不同散度展现出不同的收敛特性和遗忘-保真度权衡。

Conclusion: 该统一框架为概念遗忘提供了灵活的理论基础，允许根据具体应用和用户目标选择最优散度，实现遗忘效果与生成质量之间更精细的控制。

Abstract: Most existing methods for concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models minimize a mean squared error (MSE) loss between the denoiser outputs conditioned on a target and an anchor concept, which is implicitly the KL divergence between two Gaussians. We generalize this objective to any $f$-divergence, recovering MSE as the KL instance, and identify a family of $α$-divergences whose Gaussian closed-form yields cheap, MSE-like training objectives. For the remaining $f$-divergences, we provide a min-max objective based on the variational formulation of the $f$-divergence. We theoretically analyze and numerically validate how different $f$-divergences impact the gradient magnitude and the convergence properties of the algorithm, affecting the quality of unlearning. For instance, we observe that the Hellinger closed-form instance consistently dominates MSE across multiple scenarios. More generally, the proposed unified framework offers a flexible paradigm for selecting the optimal divergence based on the application and user goal, allowing for finer control over the trade-off between unlearning efficacy and generative fidelity.

</details>


### [384] [Position: The Hidden Costs and Measurement Gaps of Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21882)
*Fang Wu,Aaron Tu,Weihao Xuan,Heli Qi,Xu Huang,Qingcheng Zeng,Shayan Talaei,Yijia Xiao,Peng Xia,Xiangru Tang,Yuchen Zhuang,Yinxi Li,Bing Hu,Hanqun Cao,Wenqi Shi,Rui Yang,Nan Liu,Huaxiu Yao,Ge Liu,Li Erran Li,Amin Saberi,Naoto Yokoya,Jure Leskovec,Yejin Choi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出，基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型结构化任务性能方面虽被广泛报道有效，但现有评测存在三大混杂因素（预算不匹配、尝试膨胀与校准漂移、基准数据污染），导致性能提升被高估。作者提出了一套包含预算匹配饱和曲线、校准/弃权追踪、法官鲁棒性测试和污染筛查的最低标准，强调在这些控制下RLVR依然有效，但推理增益应被视为暂定的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前RLVR的评测报告常常将策略改进与三个混淆因素混为一谈：基线评估与RLVR的预算不匹配、尝试膨胀和校准漂移导致弃权被转化为自信答案、以及基准数据污染。这使得RLVR的实际能力增益被高估，可靠性成本被掩盖。

Method: 通过预算匹配的复现实验和部分提示污染探针，对照预算、提示和数据集版本进行匹配，并将受污染集视为记忆探针而非推理证据，来检验RLVR的真实效果。

Result: 多个被广泛引用的性能差距在排除混杂因素后大幅缩小或消失，表明当前测量常夸大能力增益并掩盖可靠性成本。

Conclusion: RLVR在可验证领域仍然有效且可部署，但推理增益的评估需要遵守最低标准（预算匹配饱和曲线、校准/弃权追踪、法官鲁棒性测试、污染筛查），否则应被视为暂定结论。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a practical, scalable way to improve large language models on math, code, and other structured tasks. However, we argue that many headline RLVR gains are not yet well validated because reports often conflate policy improvement with three confounds: (i) budget mismatch between RLVR and baseline evaluations, (ii) attempt inflation and calibration drift that convert abstentions into confident answers, and (iii) benchmark data contamination. Using budget-matched reproductions and partial-prompt contamination probes, we find that several widely cited gaps shrink substantially or disappear once budgets, prompts, and dataset versions are matched and contaminated sets are treated as memorization probes rather than evidence of reasoning. This does not mean that RLVR is ineffective, but it implies that current measurements often overstate capability gains and obscure reliability costs. We therefore propose a compact, tax-aware minimum standard for RLVR training and evaluation: budget-matched saturation curves with variance, calibration, and abstention tracking, a judge-robustness stress test when LLM judges are used, and an explicit contamination screen. With these controls, RLVR remains effective and deployable in verifiable domains, but reasoning gains should be treated as provisional without them.

</details>


### [385] [DiVeQ: Differentiable Vector Quantization Using the Reparameterization Trick](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.26469)
*Mohammad Hassan Vali,Tom Bäckström,Arno Solin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DiVeQ和SF-DiVeQ两种向量量化方法，通过将量化视为添加模拟量化失真的误差向量来保持前向硬赋值同时允许梯度流动，无需辅助损失或温度调度，在VQ-VAE图像压缩、VQGAN图像生成和DAC语音编码任务中提升了重建质量和样本质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度模型中常见的向量量化使用硬赋值导致梯度被阻断，阻碍了端到端训练，现有方法需要辅助损失或温度调度等额外机制来解决这一问题。

Method: DiVeQ将量化视为添加一个模拟量化失真的误差向量，在前向传播中保持硬赋值的同时允许梯度流动；SF-DiVeQ则进一步将输入分配给由码字间连线构成的曲线，减少量化误差并实现码本完全利用。

Result: 在VQ-VAE图像压缩、VQGAN图像生成和DAC语音编码任务中，DiVeQ和SF-DiVeQ在重建质量和样本质量上均优于替代量化方法。

Conclusion: 所提方法实现了端到端训练，无需辅助损失或温度调度，且在不同模态（图像、语音）和数据集上均表现出更优的量化效果。

Abstract: Vector quantization is common in deep models, yet its hard assignments block gradients and hinder end-to-end training. We propose DiVeQ, which treats quantization as adding an error vector that mimics the quantization distortion, keeping the forward pass hard while letting gradients flow. We also present a space-filling variant (SF-DiVeQ) that assigns input to a curve constructed by the lines connecting codewords, resulting in less quantization error and full codebook usage. Both methods train end-to-end without requiring auxiliary losses or temperature schedules. In VQ-VAE image compression, VQGAN image generation, and DAC speech coding tasks across various data sets, our proposed methods improve reconstruction and sample quality over alternative quantization approaches.

</details>


### [386] [Monte Carlo Permutation Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06381)
*Tristan Cazenave*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MCPS算法，通过在节点探索项中包含路径上所有落子的完整统计数据，改进了GRAVE算法。该算法适用于深度强化学习不可行或算力有限的场景（如通用游戏博弈）。在Hex、Go、AtariGo、NoGo和Wargame上测试，MCPS几乎始终优于GRAVE，并提供了消除GRAVE偏置超参数的数学推导公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当深度强化学习不可用或游戏前可用计算资源有限时（如通用游戏博弈），现有GRAVE算法存在性能瓶颈，需要一种更高效的通用蒙特卡洛树搜索算法。

Method: 在节点的探索项中融入从根节点到该节点路径上所有落子对应局面的完整统计数据，并推导了三种统计来源的加权公式，消除了GRAVE原有的偏置超参数。

Result: 在Hex、Go、AtariGo、NoGo和Wargame五种游戏中，MCPS几乎在所有测试场景下均优于GRAVE算法。

Conclusion: MCPS通过更优的统计利用方式和无偏置超参数的数学公式，显著提升了GRAVE算法的性能，为通用游戏博弈等场景提供了更有效的MCTS方案。

Abstract: We propose Monte Carlo Permutation Search (MCPS), a general-purpose Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) algorithm that improves upon the GRAVE algorithm. MCPS is relevant when deep reinforcement learning is not an option or when the computing power available before play is not substantial, such as in General Game Playing. The principle of MCPS is to include in the exploration term of a node the statistics on all the playouts that contain all the moves on the path from the root to the node. We test MCPS on a variety of games: Hex, Go, AtariGo, NoGo and a Wargame. MCPS almost always outperforms GRAVE. We also provide a mathematical derivation of the formulas used for weighting the three sources of statistics. These formulas are an improvement on the GRAVE formula since they no longer use the bias hyperparameter of GRAVE.

</details>


### [387] [MATT-CTR: Unleashing a Model-Agnostic Test-Time Paradigm for CTR Prediction with Confidence-Guided Inference Paths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08932)
*Moyu Zhang,Yun Chen,Yujun Jin,Jinxin Hu,Yu Zhang,Xiaoyi Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出模型无关的测试时范式MATT，通过分层概率哈希估计特征组合置信度，指导多推理路径生成以提升CTR模型预测鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CTR模型优化集中在训练阶段，忽略了推理阶段的优化机会；低频特征组合会导致预测不可靠。

Method: 1) 分层概率哈希方法估计不同阶特征组合的置信度；2) 以置信度为采样概率，迭代采样生成多个实例特定的推理路径；3) 聚合多路径预测分数进行鲁棒预测。

Result: 广泛的离线实验和在线A/B测试验证了MATT在现有CTR模型上的兼容性和有效性。

Conclusion: MATT通过在推理阶段利用特征组合置信度指导多路径推理，有效提升了CTR模型的预测性能，且与现有模型兼容。

Abstract: Recently, a growing body of research has focused on either optimizing CTR model architectures to better model feature interactions or refining training objectives to aid parameter learning, thereby achieving better predictive performance. However, previous efforts have primarily focused on the training phase, largely neglecting opportunities for optimization during the inference phase. Infrequently occurring feature combinations, in particular, can degrade prediction performance, leading to unreliable or low-confidence outputs. To unlock the predictive potential of trained CTR models, we propose a Model-Agnostic Test-Time paradigm (MATT), which leverages the confidence scores of feature combinations to guide the generation of multiple inference paths, thereby mitigating the influence of low-confidence features on the final prediction. Specifically, to quantify the confidence of feature combinations, we introduce a hierarchical probabilistic hashing method to estimate the occurrence frequencies of feature combinations at various orders, which serve as their corresponding confidence scores. Then, using the confidence scores as sampling probabilities, we generate multiple instance-specific inference paths through iterative sampling and subsequently aggregate the prediction scores from multiple paths to conduct robust predictions. Finally, extensive offline experiments and online A/B tests strongly validate the compatibility and effectiveness of MATT across existing CTR models.

</details>


### [388] [Cross-Receiver Generalization for RF Fingerprint Identification via Feature Disentanglement and Adversarial Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09405)
*Yuhao Pan,Xiucheng Wang,Fushuo Huo,Nan Cheng,Wenchao Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对实际部署中接收机更换导致深度神经网络RFFI性能显著下降的问题，本文提出一种解耦发射机与接收机特征的跨接收机鲁棒RFFI框架，通过对抗域对齐、接收机感知正则化和特征分离约束，在WiFi多接收机数据集上实现了优于现有方法的跨接收机识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RFFI方法依赖深度神经网络提取判别性射频特征，但实际场景中RF信号天然耦合了发射机特性和接收机依赖的失真，导致模型在更换接收机时性能显著下降，亟需一种对接收机替换鲁棒的RFFI方法。

Method: 提出跨接收机鲁棒RFFI框架，显式解耦发射机特定表示和接收机特定表示。集成对抗域对齐与接收机感知正则化以抑制发射机特征中的残余接收机信息，同时在接收机特定表示中强制接收机内一致性，并引入特征分离约束以在潜在空间中解耦两种成分。

Result: 在多接收机WiFi数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在跨接收机评估中持续优于最先进基线方法，显著提升了对接收机替换的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过显式解耦发射机与接收机特征表示，可有效解决RFFI中接收机更换导致的性能退化问题，为实际部署中的跨设备鲁棒识别提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Radio frequency fingerprint identification (RFFI) is a key technique for wireless network security, leveraging intrinsic hardware imperfections to enable transmitter identification. Although deep neural networks are effective at extracting discriminative RF features, their performance is significantly affected by receiver-induced variability in practical deployments. In real-world scenarios, RF signals inherently entangle transmitter-specific characteristics with receiver-dependent distortions, leading models to capture receiver-related patterns when training and evaluation are conducted on the same device. Consequently, replacing the receiver during deployment often results in notable performance degradation. To address this issue, we propose a cross-receiver robust RFFI framework that explicitly disentangles transmitter-specific and receiver-specific representations.
