Result: 在肿瘤分割、神经退行性疾病分类、脑年龄估计、卒中后时间预测、分子状态预测、MRI序列分类和生存建模等任务中，BrainDINO一致达到或超过自然图像和MRI特定自监督基线，在标签稀缺条件下优势尤为显著；表示分析显示其具有解剖学组织和病理敏感的特征结构。

Conclusion: 大规模切片级自监督学习能够产生统一的脑MRI表示，无需体积级预训练或全网络微调即可支持多样化神经影像任务，为鲁棒且数据高效的脑影像分析建立了可扩展的基础。

Abstract: Brain MRI underpins a wide range of neuroscientific and clinical applications, yet most learning-based methods remain task-specific and require substantial labeled data. Here we show that a single self-supervised representation can generalize across heterogeneous brain MRI endpoints. We trained BrainDINO, a self-distilled foundation model, on approximately 6.6 million unlabeled axial slices from 20 datasets encompassing broad variation in population, disease, and acquisition setting. Using a frozen encoder with lightweight task heads, BrainDINO supported transfer across tumor segmentation, neurodegenerative and neurodevelopmental conditions classification, brain age estimation, post-stroke temporal prediction, molecular status prediction, MRI sequence classification, and survival modeling. Across tasks and supervision regimes, BrainDINO consistently equaled or exceeded natural-image and MRI-specific self-supervised baselines, with particularly strong advantages under label scarcity. Representation analyses further showed anatomically organized and pathology-sensitive feature structure in the absence of task-specific supervision. Our findings indicate that large-scale slice-wise self-supervised learning can yield a unified brain MRI representation that supports diverse neuroimaging tasks without volumetric pretraining or full-network fine-tuning, establishing a scalable foundation for robust and data-efficient brain imaging analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/mclwu22/BrainDINO

</details>


### [427] [Skipping the Zeros in Diffusion Models for Sparse Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01817)
*Phil Sidney Ostheimer,Mayank Nagda,Andriy Balinskyy,Gabriel Vicente Rodrigues,Jean Radig,Carl Herrmann,Stephan Mandt,Marius Kloft,Sophie Fellenz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SED是一种专为稀疏连续数据设计的扩散模型，通过仅建模非零值来保留稀疏性，在训练和推理中跳过零值，从而在保持或提升生成质量的同时实现计算节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扩散模型针对稠密连续数据设计，无法处理稀疏连续数据中的精确零值（代表信号有意缺失），导致稀疏模式被破坏且在零值上执行不必要的计算。

Method: 提出Sparsity-Exploiting Diffusion (SED)，仅对非零值进行建模，在训练和推理过程中跳过零值，从而保留数据的原始稀疏结构。

Result: 在物理和生物学基准上，SED匹配或超越传统扩散模型及领域专用基线；视觉实验直观揭示了稠密扩散模型的局限性及SED的优势。

Conclusion: SED通过利用稀疏性实现计算效率提升和生成质量改善，是处理稀疏连续数据的有效方案。

Abstract: Diffusion models (DMs) excel on dense continuous data, but are not designed for sparse continuous data. They do not model exact zeros that represent the deliberate absence of a signal. As a result, they erase sparsity patterns and perform unnecessary computation on mostly zero entries. With Sparsity-Exploiting Diffusion (SED), we model only non-zero values, preserving sparsity. SED delivers computational savings while maintaining or improving generation quality by skipping zeros during training and inference. Across physics and biology benchmarks, SED matches or surpasses conventional DMs and domain-specific baselines, while vision experiments provide intuitive insights into the limitations of dense DMs and the benefits of SED.

</details>


### [428] [Grokking or Glitching? How Low-Precision Drives Slingshot Loss Spikes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06152)
*Liu Hanqing,Jianjun Cao,Yuanze Li,Zijian Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了深度神经网络训练中的"弹弓机制"（周期性损失尖峰）是由浮点数运算精度限制导致的数值特征膨胀（NFI）现象，而非传统认为的优化动力学问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常将深度神经网络训练中的周期性损失尖峰归因于内在的优化动力学，但其触发机制尚不明确。本文旨在揭示这一现象的真正成因。

Method: 通过理论分析和证明，揭示了在训练进入高置信阶段后，正确类logit与其他logit的差值可能超过浮点数吸收误差阈值，导致反向传播中正确类梯度被精确舍入为零，破坏了跨类别的梯度零和约束，引发参数更新的系统性漂移，形成正反馈循环。

Result: 证明了NFI机制解释了弹弓尖峰前的快速范数增长、梯度的重新出现以及损失尖峰。在更实际的任务中，部分吸收可能不产生可见尖峰，但仍会破坏零和约束并驱动参数范数快速增长。

Conclusion: 将弹弓机制重新解释为有限精度训练下的数值动力学问题，为训练后期的异常参数增长和logit发散提供了可检验的解释。

Abstract: Deep neural networks exhibit periodic loss spikes during unregularized long-term training, a phenomenon known as the "Slingshot Mechanism." Existing work usually attributes this to intrinsic optimization dynamics, but its triggering mechanism remains unclear. This paper proves that this phenomenon is a result of floating-point arithmetic precision limits. As training enters a high-confidence stage, the difference between the correct-class logit and the other logits may exceed the absorption-error threshold. Then during backpropagation, the gradient of the correct class is rounded exactly to zero, while the gradients of the incorrect classes remain nonzero. This breaks the zero-sum constraint of gradients across classes and introduces a systematic drift in the parameter update of the classifier layer. We prove that this drift forms a positive feedback loop with the feature, causing the global classifier mean and the global feature mean to grow exponentially. We call this mechanism Numerical Feature Inflation (NFI). This mechanism explains the rapid norm growth before a Slingshot spike, the subsequent reappearance of gradients, and the resulting loss spike. We further show that NFI is not equivalent to an observed loss spike: in more practical tasks, partial absorption may not produce visible spikes, but it can still break the zero-sum constraint and drive rapid growth of parameter norms. Our results reinterpret Slingshot as a numerical dynamic of finite-precision training, and provide a testable explanation for abnormal parameter growth and logit divergence in late-stage training.

</details>


### [429] [CUDABeaver: Benchmarking LLM-Based Automated CUDA Debugging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08455)
*Shiyang Li,Haoyang Chen,Mattia Fazzini,Caiwen Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CUDABEAVER基准，用于评估LLM修复真实CUDA程序故障的能力，并提出协议感知指标pass@k(M,C,A)，揭示性能约束会显著影响修复成功率的测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CUDA调试长期困难，原因在于硬件行为、编译器决策、内存层次和异步执行之间的微妙交互。随着GPU应用扩展，LLM生成的CUDA程序常出现故障，但现有评估方法存在"退化修复"问题——模型通过简化代码来通过正确性测试，却牺牲了原始优化结构。需要更真实的调试评估基准。

Method: 构建CUDABEAVER基准，从LLM生成CUDA过程中产生的真实故障工作区中提取213个任务，每个任务提供故障代码、构建/测试命令、原始错误证据和单个可编辑文件。提出pass@k(M,C,A)指标，将修复器M、语料C和协议A三个轴显式化，以区分真正的修复和"退化通过"。

Result: 在213个任务和7个前沿LLM上的实验表明，协议感知评估能更真实反映CUDA调试能力：当性能损失容忍度高时，修复器表现看似很强；但即使小幅收紧性能要求，测量的成功率会急剧下降，分数波动高达40个百分点。

Conclusion: CUDABEAVER揭示了LLM在CUDA调试中的退化修复问题，协议感知指标表明性能约束对评估结果影响显著，现有评估可能高估了模型的CUDA调试能力。

Abstract: Debugging CUDA programs has long been challenging because failures often arise from subtle interactions among hardware behavior, compiler decisions, memory hierarchy, and asynchronous execution. More importantly, with the rapid expansion of GPU usage across scientific computing, machine learning, graphics, and systems workloads, CUDA debugging has become more challenging than ever. Current evaluations of LLM-based CUDA programming largely miss this setting: a model can pass correctness tests with repair by degeneration, simplifying the CUDA code into a safer but slower program that abandons the original optimization structure. We introduce CUDABEAVER, a benchmark for CUDA debugging from real failing workspaces produced during LLM-based CUDA generation. Each task provides the broken candidate, native build/test commands, raw error evidence, and a single editable file. CUDABEAVER evaluates whether a fixer truly repairs the failing CUDA code or merely finds a slower test-passing replacement, reporting results by failure category, debugging trajectory, stagnation mode, and performance preservation. We further propose pass@k(M,C,A), a protocol-conditional CUDA debugging metric by making the fixer M, corpus C, and protocol axes Aexplicit. Using this metric across 213 tasks and seven frontier LLMs, we show that protocol-aware evaluation gives a more faithful view of CUDA debugging ability: when performance-loss tolerance is high, fixers appear much stronger, but even a minor stricter performance requirement can sharply reduce measured success, shifting scores by up to 40 percentage points.

</details>


### [430] [Test-Time Compute for Dense Retrieval: Agentic Program Generation with Frozen Embedding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11374)
*Han Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 测试时计算不仅能提升大型推理模型，也能提升小型嵌入模型。通过代理程序搜索循环，在不重新训练的情况下，从冻结的编码器API中发现12个帕累托最优程序，在14个MMTEB检索任务上均提升nDCG@10，且无需修改即可迁移到未见过的编码器家族和19个预留检索任务中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究测试时计算是否仅对大型推理模型有效，验证其对小型嵌入模型同样有益。

Method: 采用代理程序搜索循环，在冻结编码器API上探索144个候选程序，发现12个帕累托最优程序，涵盖成本比从1.2到14.7。

Result: 所有前沿程序在14个MMTEB检索任务上均提升nDCG@10；68%的模型-任务对在19个预留任务上存在至少一个提升性能的前沿程序。

Conclusion: 测试时计算对小型嵌入模型同样有效，发现的程序无需训练或外部模型，且具有良好的迁移性。

Abstract: Test-time compute is widely believed to benefit only large reasoning models. We show it also helps small embedding models. Since modern embedding models are distilled from LLM backbones, a frozen encoder should benefit from extra inference compute without retraining. An agentic program-search loop explores 144 candidate programs over a frozen encoder API and produces twelve Pareto-optimal programs spanning cost ratios from $c=1.2$ to $14.7$ over the single-pass baseline. The search independently rediscovers Rocchio pseudo-relevance feedback, ColBERT-style MaxSim at sentence granularity, reciprocal rank fusion, and the Fisher linear discriminant, all without trainable parameters or external models. Every frontier program improves nDCG@10 over the frozen baseline across all 14 MMTEB retrieval tasks spanning legal, financial, long-document, and general domains. The programs transfer without modification to unseen encoder families and nineteen held-out retrieval tasks, with 68% of model-task pairs admitting at least one frontier program that improves over the cosine baseline.

</details>


### [431] [MinT: Managed Infrastructure for Training and Serving Millions of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13779)
*Mind Lab,:,Song Cao,Vic Cao,Andrew Chen,Kaijie Chen,Cleon Cheng,Steven Chiang,Kaixuan Fan,Hera Feng,Huan Feng,Arthur Fu,Jun Gao,Hongquan Gu,Aaron Guan,Nolan Ho,Mutian Hong,Hailee Hou,Peixuan Hua,Charles Huang,Miles Jiang,Nora Jiang,Yuyi Jiang,Qiuyu Jin,Fancy Kong,Andrew Lei,Kyrie Lei,Alexy Li,Lucian Li,Ray Li,Theo Li,Zhihui Li,Jiayi Lin,Kairus Liu,Kieran Liu,Logan Liu,Xiang Liu,Irvine Lu,Maeve Luo,Runze Lv,Pony Ma,Verity Niu,Anson Qiu,Vincent Wang,Rio Yang,Maxwell Yao,Carrie Ye,Regis Ye,Wenlin Ye,Josh Ying,Danney Zeng,Yuhan Zhan,Anya Zhang,Di Zhang,Ruijia Zhang,Sueky Zhang,Ya Zhang,Wei Zhao,Ada Zhou,Changhai Zhou,Yuhua Zhou,Xinyue Zhu,Murphy Zhuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MindLab Toolkit (MinT) 是一个用于LoRA后训练和在线服务的托管基础设施系统，支持在共享的万亿级基础模型上管理百万级LoRA策略目录，通过Scale Up（扩展到前沿规模）、Scale Down（仅移动适配器，减少18.3x步进时间）和Scale Out（分离策略寻址与工作集，支持10^6级可寻址目录）三条轴扩展路径，实现训练和服务的规模化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在仅有少量昂贵基座模型部署的情况下，会产生大量训练策略。传统方法将每个策略物化为完整检查点效率低下，需要一种让基座模型常驻、仅移动LoRA适配器的方法来降低成本。

Method: 提出MinT系统，通过Scale Up（扩展到稠密和MoE架构，包括MLA和DSA注意力路径）、Scale Down（仅导出LoRA适配器，适配器大小可小于基座模型的1%；采用适配器仅切换减少步进时间；并发多策略GRPO缩短墙钟时间）、Scale Out（分离策略可寻址性与工作集，支持10^6级可寻址目录和千级适配器活跃波，冷加载作为调度服务工作，打包MoE LoRA张量提升加载速度8.5-8.7x）三条路径。

Result: 验证了超过1T总参数的训练和服务；适配器仅切换在4B稠密模型上减少18.3x步进时间，在30B MoE上减少2.85x；并发多策略GRPO墙钟时间分别缩短1.77x和1.45x且不增加峰值内存；单引擎扫描通过100K策略；打包MoE LoRA张量提升引擎加载8.5-8.7x。

Conclusion: MinT能够管理百万级LoRA策略目录，同时在共享的万亿级基座模型上训练和服务选定的适配器修订版本。

Abstract: We present MindLab Toolkit (MinT), a managed infrastructure system for Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) post-training and online serving. MinT targets a setting where many trained policies are produced over a small number of expensive base-model deployments. Instead of materializing each policy as a merged full checkpoint, MinT keeps the base model resident and moves exported LoRA adapter revisions through rollout, update, export, evaluation, serving, and rollback, hiding distributed training, serving, scheduling, and data movement behind a service interface. MinT scales this path along three axes. Scale Up extends LoRA RL to frontier-scale dense and MoE architectures, including MLA and DSA attention paths, with training and serving validated beyond 1T total parameters. Scale Down moves only the exported LoRA adapter, which can be under 1% of base-model size in rank-1 settings; adapter-only handoff reduces the measured step by 18.3x on a 4B dense model and 2.85x on a 30B MoE, while concurrent multi-policy GRPO shortens wall time by 1.77x and 1.45x without raising peak memory. Scale Out separates durable policy addressability from CPU/GPU working sets: a tensor-parallel deployment supports 10^6-scale addressable catalogs (measured single-engine sweeps through 100K) and thousand-adapter active waves at cluster scale, with cold loading treated as scheduled service work and packed MoE LoRA tensors improving live engine loading by 8.5-8.7x. MinT thus manages million-scale LoRA policy catalogs while training and serving selected adapter revisions over shared 1T-class base models.

</details>


### [432] [Identifiable Token Correspondence for World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16457)
*Youngin Kim,Ray Sun,Inho Kim,Bumsoo Park,Hyun Oh Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可识别Token对应关系（ITC），将基于token的Transformer世界模型的下一帧预测建模为结构化分配问题，通过复制上一帧token或生成新token来保持时间一致性，在不改变架构和训练过程的情况下显著提升性能，在Craftax-classic基准上达到72.5%回报率和35.6%分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于token的Transformer世界模型在长程 rollout 中常出现物体重复、消失和变形等时间不一致性问题。根本原因在于现有方法将下一帧预测纯粹视为token生成问题，忽略了token在时间维度上的持续性。

Method: 提出可识别Token对应关系（ITC），在解码阶段引入潜在token对应变量，将下一帧预测形式化为结构化分配问题：每个下一帧token要么从上一帧复制，要么新生成。ITC不改变Transformer架构和训练流程，可作为现有骨干网络的附加模块。

Result: 在4个挑战性基准上达到最先进性能，Craftax-classic基准上回报率72.5%（之前最佳67.4%），分数35.6%（之前最佳27.9%）。

Conclusion: ITC通过显式建模token跨时间对应关系，有效解决了世界模型长程推演中的时间不一致性问题，是一种轻量高效、即插即用的方法。

Abstract: Token-based transformer world models have shown strong performance in visual reinforcement learning, but often suffer from temporal inconsistency in long-horizon rollouts, including object duplication, disappearance, and transmutation. A key reason is that most existing approaches treat next-frame prediction purely as a token generation problem, without considering the persistence of tokens across time. We introduce Identifiable Token Correspondence (ITC), a decoding step for token-based transformer world models that formulates next-frame prediction as a structured assignment problem with latent token correspondence variables: each next-frame token is explained either by copying a token from the previous frame or by generating a new one. ITC leaves the transformer architecture and training procedure unchanged and can be added on top of existing backbones. Our experiments show state-of-the-art performance on 4 challenging benchmarks. The proposed method achieves a return of 72.5% and a score of 35.6% on the Craftax-classic benchmark, significantly surpassing the previous best of 67.4% and 27.9%. We release our source code on https://github.com/snu-mllab/Identifiable-Token-Correspondence.

</details>


### [433] [AMARIS: A Memory-Augmented Rubric Improvement System for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18592)
*Peilin Wu,Xinlu Zhang,Kun Wan,Wentian Zhao,Gang Wu,Xinya Du,Zhiyu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AMARIS是一种基于记忆增强的评估标准改进系统，通过存储和检索纵向训练证据来动态更新评估标准，相比静态、局部自适应和无记忆基线方法，在科学、医学、指令遵循和创意写作等任务上取得了显著提升（如GPQA-Diamond +2.8分，IFBench +2.2分）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应评估标准方法仅依赖当前批次或实例级比较等局部证据来更新标准，丢弃了训练过程中产生的诊断信息，导致难以跟踪重复失败、评估先前标准编辑效果或在早期标准饱和后提升标准。

Method: AMARIS包含持久化评估记忆模块，存储展开分析、步骤级摘要和标准更新记录，检索近期和语义相关的历史信息来修订评估标准；采用异步运行机制，减少相比同步更新的阻塞延迟。

Result: 在科学、医学、指令遵循和创意写作任务上，AMARIS在全局和实例特定评估标准设置下均优于静态、局部自适应和无记忆消融基线，例如在GPQA-Diamond上提升2.8分，在IFBench上提升2.2分。

Conclusion: 记忆机制减少了震荡性标准编辑，支持从早期错误纠正到后期课程进阶的渐进式改进，异步运行降低了阻塞延迟。

Abstract: Rubric-based reward shaping provides interpretable and editable reward signals for fine-tuning LLMs via reinforcement learning (RL), but existing adaptive rubric methods typically update criteria from local evidence such as the current batch or instance-level comparisons. This local view discards diagnostic information produced during training, making it difficult to track recurring failures, evaluate previous rubric edits, or raise standards once earlier criteria become saturated. We introduce AMARIS, A Memory-Augmented Rubric Improvement System that grounds rubric updates in longitudinal training evidence. AMARIS stores rollout analyses, step-level summaries, and rubric update records in a persistent evaluation memory, then retrieves recent and semantically relevant history to revise rubrics. We evaluate AMARIS across science, medicine, instruction following, and creative writing under both global and instance-specific rubric settings. AMARIS improves over static, local-adaptive, and memory-ablated baselines, such as +2.8 points on GPQA-Diamond and +2.2 points on IFBench over the strongest baselines, while analysis shows that memory reduces oscillatory rubric edits and supports a progression from early failure correction to later curriculum advancement. AMARIS runs asynchronously alongside the normal RL loop, reducing blocking latency relative to synchronous rubric updates.

</details>


### [434] [PDEInvBench: A Comprehensive Dataset and Design Space Exploration of Neural Networks for PDE Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25353)
*Divyam Goel,Nithin Chalapathi,Sanjeev Raja,Aditi S. Krishnapriyan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了PDEInvBench，首个面向偏微分方程逆问题的综合基准数据集，涵盖多种时变和时不变PDE的数值模拟，并沿优化流程、问题表示和规模扩展三个维度系统探索了神经网络的设计空间，揭示了若干实用洞见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习PDE基准主要关注正问题（从参数到解场），缺乏针对逆问题（从解场到物理参数）的系统研究和标准数据集，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 构建了包含多种PDE数值模拟的综合基准数据集PDEInvBench，设计了分布内和多种分布外评估划分，并沿三个关键维度（监督/自监督/测试时训练等优化策略、不同归纳偏好的架构设计及条件注入方式、模型与数据规模扩展）进行系统实验。

Result: 1) 两阶段训练（先监督预训练+后用PDE残差微调）效果最佳；2) 输入中引入PDE导数特征持续提升精度；3) 增加训练数据中初始条件的多样性比扩展PDE参数范围带来更大性能提升。

Conclusion: PDEInvBench为PDE逆问题的神经网络方法提供了标准化评估平台，所得实用洞见可为后续研究提供指导，数据集与代码均已公开。

Abstract: Inverse problems in partial differential equations (PDEs) involve estimating the physical parameters of a system from observed spatiotemporal solution fields. Neural networks are well-suited for PDE parameter estimation due to their capability to model function-to-function space transformations. While existing benchmarks of machine learning methods for PDEs primarily focus on the forward problem, there are no similar comprehensive studies and benchmark datasets on PDE inverse problems, i.e., mapping solution fields to underlying physical parameters. We fill this gap by introducing PDEInvBench, a comprehensive benchmark dataset consisting of numerical simulations for both time-dependent and time-independent PDEs across a wide range of physical behaviors and parameters. Our dataset includes evaluation splits that assess performance in both in-distribution and various out-of-distribution settings. Using our benchmark dataset, we comprehensively explore the design space of neural networks for PDE inverse problems along three key dimensions: (1) optimization procedures, analyzing the role of supervised, self-supervised, and test-time training objectives on performance, (2) problem representations, where we study the value of architectural choices with different inductive biases and various conditioning strategies, and (3) scaling, which we perform with respect to both model and data size. Our experiments reveal several practical insights: 1) neural networks perform best with a two-stage training procedure: initial supervision with PDE parameters followed by test-time fine-tuning using the PDE residual, 2) incorporating PDE derivatives as input features consistently improves accuracy, and 3) increasing the diversity of initial conditions in the training data yields greater performance gains than expanding the range of PDE parameters. We make our dataset and codebase publicly available.

</details>


### [435] [SPHERICAL KV: Angle-Domain Attention and Rate-Distortion Retention for Efficient Long-Context Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18856)
*Anay Chauhan,Gurucharan Marthi Krishna Kumar,Arion Das,Amit Dhanda,Vinija Jain,Aman Chadha,Amitava Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Spherical KV提出了一种基于注意力几何结构的球形KV缓存方法，通过角度域注意力（ADA）和率失真保留（RDR）两个组件，在减少KV缓存内存占用的同时保持解码效率，直接解决长上下文推理中HBM带宽瓶颈问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中KV缓存的内存占用随上下文长度增长而增加，解码过程受限于HBM流式传输而非计算能力。现有方法（如驱逐、窗口、量化、卸载）虽减少了内存占用，但未充分解决关键路径瓶颈，尤其是压缩后的状态在解码时仍需重建为稠密向量。

Method: 提出Spherical KV方法，包含两个组件：(i) 角度域注意力（ADA），将键存储为球面参数化（标量半径+紧凑角度编码），直接从编码计算注意力logits，避免重建稠密键；(ii) 率失真保留（RDR），在固定预算下联合选择每个token和head的保留/丢弃决策及精度层级，生成层级同构的页面。

Result: ADA保持了分页、块局部、融合友好的解码路径，直接减少HBM流量；RDR通过轻量元数据和合并读取实现层级同构页面的高效管理。两者共同在减少KV内存驻留的同时保持解码效率。

Conclusion: Spherical KV将KV分配视为基于注意力几何的率失真问题，为长上下文推理提供了面向部署的KV缓存压缩机制，有效平衡了内存占用与解码效率。

Abstract: Long-context inference is increasingly constrained by the KV cache: resident memory grows with context length, and decoding becomes limited by repeated High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) streaming rather than arithmetic. Existing methods such as eviction, windowing, quantization, and offloading reduce footprint, but often leave the critical-path bottleneck only partially addressed, especially when compressed states must still be reconstructed into dense vectors during decoding.
  We present Spherical KV, a long-context inference method that treats KV allocation as a rate-distortion problem grounded in attention geometry for efficient decoding. The method is built on two ideas: (i) represent directional information cheaply in the decode hot loop, and (ii) allocate retention and precision according to estimated future utility. Its first component, Angle-Domain Attention (ADA), stores keys in a spherical parameterization consisting of a scalar radius and compact angle codes, and computes attention logits directly from these codes without reconstructing dense keys. This preserves a paged, block-local, fusion-friendly decode path and directly targets HBM traffic in realistic serving settings. Its second component, Rate-Distortion Retention (RDR), jointly chooses keep/drop decisions and precision tiers per token and head under a fixed budget, producing tier-homogeneous pages with lightweight metadata and coalesced reads. Together, ADA and RDR provide a deployment-oriented mechanism for reducing KV residency while preserving decode efficiency.

</details>


### [436] [FLUIDSPLAT: Reconstructing Physical Fields from Sparse Sensors via Gaussian Primitives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18866)
*Huaxi Huang,Meng Li,Zhengqing Gao,Xi Zhou,Xiaoshui Huang,Xiao Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FLUIDSPLAT是一种受3D高斯泼溅启发的传感器条件模型，用于从稀疏表面传感器重建连续流场。它预测K个各向异性高斯基元形成分区统一支架，作为空间可解释的中间表示。理论分析表明，在高斯基元估计器下，逼近率为O(K^{-s/d})，且稀疏感知下基元数量存在方差瓶颈(K*∼(N/σ²)^{d/(2s+d)})，为此补充了状态条件残差解码器。在4个2D/3D基准上实现11-28%的误差降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经方法将传感器读数编码为隐式潜码，缺乏空间可解释性，且缺乏表示能力随观测数量扩展的正式指导。

Method: 提出FLUIDSPLAT：预测K个各向异性高斯基元形成分区统一支架（空间显式中间表示），结合理论分析推导逼近率和方差瓶颈，并补充状态条件残差解码器。

Result: 在圆柱绕流、AirfRANS、FlowBench LDC-3D、PhySense-Car 3D四个基准上，相比多个强基线实现11-28%的误差降低。

Conclusion: 高斯基元表示具有理论保证的空间可解释性；稀疏感知下基元数量不能自由增长，存在方差瓶颈；残差解码器可有效弥补该瓶颈。

Abstract: Reconstructing continuous flow fields from sparse surface-mounted sensors is central to aerodynamic design, flow control, and digital-twin instrumentation. Existing neural methods for this task typically encode sensor readings into implicit latent codes with little spatial interpretability and limited formal guidance on how representational capacity should scale with observation count. Inspired by 3D Gaussian Splatting, we introduce FLUIDSPLAT, a sensor-conditioned model that predicts K anisotropic Gaussian primitives forming a partition-of-unity scaffold, a spatially explicit and interpretable intermediate representation of the flow. For an idealized Gaussian primitive estimator, we prove an $O(K^{-s/d})$ approximation rate for fields with Sobolev smoothness $s$; incorporating $N$ noisy observations yields a squared-risk decomposition with bias $O(K^{-2s/d})$ and variance $O(σ^{2}K/N)$.Balancing the two yields $K^{*}\!\sim\!(N/σ^{2})^{d/(2s+d)}$: primitive count cannot grow freely under sparse sensing, revealing a variance bottleneck that motivates complementing the scaffold with a state-conditioned residual decoder. Across four benchmarks spanning 2D and 3D, FLUIDSPLAT achieves 11-28% error reduction over several strong baselines on cylinder flow, AirfRANS, FlowBench LDC-3D, and PhySense-Car 3D benchmarks.

</details>


### [437] [Your Neighbors Know: Leveraging Local Neighborhoods for Backdoor Detection in Decentralized Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19969)
*Sayan Biswas,Antoine Boutet,Davide Frey,Romaric Gaudel,Rachid Guerraoui,Maxime Jacovella,Anne-Marie Kermarrec,Dimitri Lerévérend,François Taïani,Martijn de Vos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Argus是一种去中心化学习中的后门攻击检测框架，通过节点间协作共享触发器并用结构相似性度量区分真假攻击，在无中心服务器条件下有效降低攻击成功率达90%，同时保证模型效用接近理论最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化学习中的后门攻击问题尚未被充分研究，现有防御方案往往忽略了去中心化学习的约束条件（如无中心服务器），亟需一种原生适配去中心化环境的后门检测方法。

Method: 诚实节点本地分析接收到的模型更新以识别潜在后门触发器；节点间共享触发器信息并利用结构相似性度量区分真实后门与由数据异质性引起的误报；拒绝未通过协作测试的模型更新并驱逐持续发送恶意更新的节点。

Result: 在三个标准数据集上对比三种基线方法，Argus将攻击成功率降低多达90个百分点，模型效用与理想化基准的差距在5个百分点以内；且数据异质性越大时Argus相比基线的优势越明显。

Conclusion: 首次为去中心化学习场景下的后门检测机制提供了理论收敛保证，证明以高概率过滤可疑模型更新能维持与标准去中心化学习相当的收敛速率。

Abstract: Decentralized learning (DL) is an emerging machine learning paradigm where nodes collaboratively train models without a central server. However, the collaborative nature of DL makes it vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where a model is taught to behave normally on standard inputs while executing hidden, malicious actions when encountering data with specific triggers. Backdoor attacks in DL remain understudied and existing defenses often overlook DL constraints. We introduce Argus, a novel backdoor detection framework native to DL that requires neither a central coordinator nor prior knowledge of the trigger. In Argus, honest nodes locally analyze received model updates to identify potential backdoor triggers. Nodes then collectively share their triggers with their neighbors and use a structural similarity metric to separate true backdoors from false alarms induced by data heterogeneity. A key insight is that false positive triggers exhibit inconsistencies across participants while true positive ones show consistent patterns. Model updates that fail this collaborative test are rejected, and persistently malicious senders are eventually evicted. We provide the first theoretical convergence guarantees for a DL-specific backdoor detection mechanism, showing that filtering out suspicious model updates with high probability preserves a convergence rate comparable to standard DL. We implement and evaluate Argus on three standard datasets and against three state-of-the-art baselines. Across settings, Argus reduces attack success rates by up to 90 points compared to no defense, while preserving model utility within 5 percentage points of an omniscient oracle. Furthermore, the effectiveness of Argus compared to baselines improves as data heterogeneity increases.

</details>


### [438] [Weasel: Out-of-Domain Generalization for Web Agents via Importance-Diversity Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20291)
*Fatemeh Pesaran Zadeh,Seyeon Choi,Xing Han Lù,Siva Reddy,Gunhee Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Weasel是一种针对Web智能体的轨迹选择方法，通过平衡一元重要性与成对多样性来选择固定预算的子集，结合以目标为中心的AXTree剪枝和风格一致的推理链，实现离线训练加速（约9.7-12.5倍）并提升跨域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM驱动的Web智能体在微调后跨域泛化能力差，且离线训练因噪声轨迹、冗余数据和长AXTree状态导致计算效率低下。

Method: (1) Weasel轨迹选择：优化一个平衡一元重要性（unary importance）与状态、网站、交互模式上的成对多样性（pairwise diversity）的目标函数，用贪心算法高效求解固定预算子集；(2) 以目标为中心的AXTree剪枝：仅保留围绕真实动作目标的内容；(3) 风格匹配：用模型生成的、风格一致的推理链替换专家轨迹，缓解推理原生模型的风格不匹配问题。

Result: 在AgentTrek和NNetNav训练集上，使用Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma3-4B、Qwen3-8B模型，在WebArena、WorkArena、MiniWob评测中，Weasel提升了跨域性能并降低了训练成本，实现约9.7-12.5倍的训练加速。

Conclusion: Weasel通过联合优化轨迹选择、AXTree剪枝和风格对齐，有效解决了Web智能体离线训练中的效率与泛化瓶颈。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled web agents that follow natural language goals through multi-step browser interactions. However, agents fine-tuned on specific trajectories and domain often struggle to generalize out of domain, and offline training can be compute-inefficient due to noisy, redundant trajectories and long accessibility-tree (AXTree) states. To address both issues, we propose Weasel, a trajectory selection method for offline training of web agents. Weasel selects a fixed-budget subset of trajectory steps by optimizing an objective that balances unary importance with pairwise diversity over states, websites, and interaction patterns, solving efficiently with a greedy algorithm. We further improve efficiency with target-centered AXTree pruning that keeps only content around the ground-truth action target, and we mitigate style mismatch for reasoning-native models by replacing expert traces with model-generated, style-consistent rationales. Across AgentTrek and NNetNav training datasets, evaluations in WebArena, WorkArena, and MiniWob, and experiments with Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma3-4B, and Qwen3-8B, Weasel improves out-of-domain performance while reducing training cost, producing roughly 9.7-12.5$\times$ training speedups over standard fine-tuning. We make the code available at https://github.com/fatemehpesaran310/weasel.

</details>


### [439] [Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20612)
*Ziye Chen,Hongbin Lin,Xinyue Xu,Jie Li,Lijie Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Matryoshka概念瓶颈模型(MCBM)，通过嵌套层级组织概念，实现在单个模型中自适应调整概念粒度，将人工干预成本从线性降至对数级O(log K)，同时保证性能单调提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型(CBM)存在结构局限性：要么使用单一静态概念集导致专家必须穷举标注所有概念，干预成本高昂；要么针对不同概念预算训练多个模型，造成巨大的计算和维护开销。亟需一种统一的架构实现自适应概念利用。

Method: 受Matryoshka表示学习启发，MCBM基于最大相关性和最小冗余度原则，将概念组织成嵌套层级结构。单个模型支持无需重新训练即可在不同概念粒度级别进行推理，实现自适应概念利用。

Result: 理论证明了预期干预成本从线性降至对数级O(log K)，并保证性能单调提升。实验表明MCBM在匹配独立训练模型性能的同时，实现了动态高效的专家交互。

Conclusion: MCBM通过统一架构解决了CBM可解释性与干预成本之间的权衡问题，为可解释深度学习在实际部署中提供了一种高效且实用的方案。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) have emerged as a prominent paradigm for interpretable deep learning, learning by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, their practical deployment is hindered by the high cost of test-time intervention, as correcting model errors typically requires human experts to manually inspect and verify a large set of predicted concepts. Existing approaches suffer from a fundamental structural limitation: they either adopt a single static concept set, forcing experts to exhaustively annotate concepts and incurring prohibitive intervention costs, or train multiple models tailored to different concept budgets, resulting in substantial computational and maintenance overhead. To address this challenge, we propose the Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Model (MCBM), a unified architecture that enables adaptive concept utilization within a single model. Inspired by Matryoshka Representation Learning, MCBM organizes concepts into a nested hierarchy based on maximum relevance and minimum redundancy, allowing inference at multiple levels of conceptual granularity without retraining. Theoretically, we show that MCBM reduces the expected intervention costs from linear to logarithmic order, $O(\log K)$, while guaranteeing monotonic performance improvement. Empirically, extensive experiments demonstrate that MCBM matches the performance of independently trained models while enabling dynamic and efficient expert interaction.

</details>


### [440] [A Sharper Picture of Generalization in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20988)
*Paul Lintilhac,Sair Shaikh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从傅里叶谱角度研究Transformer在布尔域上的泛化行为，利用PAC-Bayes理论证明稀疏低阶谱可实现良好泛化，解释了思维链为何提升高阶目标函数的泛化能力，并通过实验和机制可解释性研究验证理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作（Edelman et al., 2022; Trauger & Tosh, 2024）通过Rademacher复杂度推导泛化界，本文则探索利用PAC-Bayes理论获得泛化界的可行性，旨在从不同理论视角理解Transformer的泛化行为。

Method: 1) 证明存在实现任意稀疏度不超过上下文长度的布尔函数的平坦最小值；2) 对理想化低锐度学习器应用PAC-Bayes界，得到非平凡的泛化界；3) 通过性质检验高效估计复杂度参数；4) 进行实验和机制可解释性研究验证理论构造的现实性。

Result: 稀疏低阶谱可实现低锐度构造并具备良好泛化性质；得到非平凡的PAC-Bayes泛化界；为思维链提升高阶目标函数泛化能力提供了形式化解释；复杂度参数可通过性质检验高效估计。

Conclusion: PAC-Bayes理论能有效推导Transformer的泛化界，稀疏低阶谱是关键条件；思维链通过分解高阶函数为低阶子任务来改善泛化；理论构造在真实Transformer中具有现实性。

Abstract: We study transformers' generalization behavior on boolean domains from the perspective of the Fourier spectra of their target functions. In contrast to prior work (Edelman et al., 2022; Trauger & Tosh, 2024), which derived generalization bounds from Rademacher complexity, we investigate the feasibility of obtaining generalization bounds via PAC-Bayes theory. We show that sparse spectra concentrated on low-degree components enable low-sharpness constructions with good generalization properties. Our idea is to show the existence of flat minima implementing any boolean function of sparsity no greater than the context length, and then apply a PAC-Bayes bound to an idealized low-sharpness learner, resulting in a non-vacuous generalization bound. We use this to give a formal account of why chain-of-thought improves generalization for high-degree target functions, and show that the complexity parameters in our bound can be efficiently estimated via property testing. We evaluate predictions empirically and conduct a mechanistic interpretability study to support the realism of our theoretical construction in real transformers.

</details>


### [441] [$\textit{BlockFormer}$ : Transformer-based inference from interaction maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21617)
*Eloïse Touron,Pedro L. C. Rodrigues,Julyan Arbel,Nelle Varoquaux,Michael Arbel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Transformer架构的数据驱动方法，通过模拟器生成合成数据训练模型，利用交互图谱（如Hi-C）中的共享结构，解决可变数量和大小的实体推断问题。在着丝粒定位任务上，该方法能在多种物种中准确恢复其基因组位置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将着丝粒识别等交互图谱推断问题形式化为通用逆问题，解决实际数据中实体数量和大小可变、以及图谱间局部模式需全局对齐的挑战。

Method: 采用Transformer架构处理可变序列输入，配合定制模拟器生成大量低成本合成数据进行训练，实现数据驱动下的跨图谱共享结构学习。

Result: 在多种基因组大小的物种上，着丝粒定位准确率显著提升，验证了方法的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该数据驱动方法有效解决了交互图谱推断中实体可变性和模式对齐问题，为着丝粒定位等逆问题提供了通用解决方案。

Abstract: Inference from interaction maps, such as centromere identification from genome-wide chromosome conformation capture techniques -- notably Hi-C -- can be formulated as a generic inverse problem: infer a set of parameters given a map summarizing pairwise interactions between entities through blocks of variable numbers and sizes. In this work, we introduce a data-driven approach that leverages shared structure between these maps, such as global alignment between localized patterns, while handling the variability in number and size of entities arising in real-world data. Our approach relies on a transformer architecture capable of handling such variability and a custom simulator to generate abundant, yet computationally cheap synthetic data for training. Applied to the problem of centromere localization, the method accurately recovers their genomic positions across a wide range of species of various genome sizes.

</details>


### [442] [One LR Doesn't Fit All: Heavy-Tail Guided Layerwise Learning Rates for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22297)
*Di He,Songjun Tu,Keyu Wang,Lu Yin,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Layerwise Learning Rate（LLR），一种基于重尾自正则化理论为Transformer各层分配不同学习率的自适应方案，实现了更快的训练收敛和更好的泛化性能，在60M到3B参数规模的模型上最高提升1.5倍训练速度，并将3B模型的零样本准确率从48.58%提升至50.61%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习实践中对所有层使用统一学习率的做法忽视了Transformer架构的结构异质性，这限制了LLM作为骨干网络的训练效率和效果。

Method: 基于重尾自正则化理论，通过权重相关矩阵的经验谱密度量化各层的重尾性，对重尾性较弱的层分配较大学习率以加速训练，对重尾性较强的层分配较小学习率，实现层间更均衡的训练。

Result: 在LLaMA、GPT-nano等架构，AdamW和Muon等优化器，60M到3B参数规模及高达100B训练token的实验中，LLR实现了最高1.5倍训练加速，1B模型零样本准确率从47.09%提升至49.02%，3B模型从48.58%提升至50.61%。

Conclusion: LLR是一种低调参开销的有效方案，其学习率设置可直接从统一基线迁移，为Transformer的层自适应训练提供了理论驱动的实用方法。

Abstract: Learning rate configuration is a fundamental aspect of modern deep learning. The prevailing practice of applying a uniform learning rate across all layers overlooks the structural heterogeneity of Transformers, potentially limiting their effectiveness as the backbone of Large Language Models (LLMs). In this paper, we introduce Layerwise Learning Rate (LLR), an adaptive scheme that assigns distinct learning rates to individual Transformer layers. Our method is grounded in Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR) theory, which characterizes the empirical spectral density (ESD) of weight correlation matrices to quantify heavy-tailedness. Layers with weaker heavy-tailedness are assigned larger learning rates to accelerate training, while layers with stronger heavy-tailedness receive smaller learning rates. By tailoring learning rates in this manner, LLR promotes more balanced training across layers, leading to faster convergence and improved generalization. Extensive experiments across architectures ranging from LLaMA to GPT-nano, optimizers including AdamW and Muon, and model scales from 60M to 3B parameters with up to 100B training tokens demonstrate the effectiveness of LLR. LLR achieves up to 1.5x training speedup and consistently outperforms uniform-learning-rate baselines. In particular, it improves the average zero-shot accuracy of 1B models from 47.09% to 49.02%, and that of 3B models from 48.58% to 50.61%. A key advantage of LLR is its low tuning overhead: it can transfer nearly optimal learning-rate settings directly from the uniform baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/hed-ucas/Layer-wise-Learning-Rate.

</details>


### [443] [BioFormer: Rethinking Cross-Subject Generalization via Spectral Structural Alignment in Biomedical Time-Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22468)
*Guikang Du,Haoran Li,Xinyu Liu,Zhibo Zhang,Xiaoli Gong,Jin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BioFormer通过频谱漂移视角显式建模个体间变异性，利用频带对齐模块（FBAM）和样本条件层归一化在六个生物医学时间序列数据集上实现跨主体泛化，F1分数提升6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法隐式抑制BTS表示中的个体特异性变异，缺乏显式建模手段，导致跨主体泛化性能受限。

Method: 提出BioFormer，核心组件为频带对齐模块（FBAM），通过从频谱分布生成带级调制因子自适应调整幅度和相位以对齐频谱结构；结合样本条件层归一化，从信号内在统计量而非主体身份推断归一化参数。

Result: 在六个数据集上超越12个基线方法，绝对F1分数提升6%。

Conclusion: 引入频谱漂移作为描述个体特异性变异的新视角，并证明显式建模频谱结构对齐可有效提升跨主体泛化性能。

Abstract: Cross-subject generalization in biomedical time-series refers to training on data from some subjects and testing on unseen subjects.The key challenge is to suppress subject specific variability in BTS representations.Most existing methods implicitly suppress the variability through model building or subject adversarial learning, but rarely model it explicitly.We introduce spectral drift as a new perspective to characterize subject specific variability.Specifically, BTS signals under the same label often share consistent oscillatory structure, yet exhibit subject-dependent magnitude or phase shifts in specific frequency components, which we interpret as subject-specific variability. Building on this insight, we propose BioFormer.At its core is a Frequency-Band Alignment Module(FBAM) that generates band-wise modulation factors from the spectral distribution and adaptively adjusts amplitude and phase to align spectral structure, thereby mitigating variability.We further pair FBAM with Sample Conditional Layer Normalization, which infers normalization parameters from intrinsic signal statistics rather than subject identity, stabilizing cross-subject representations.Extensive experiments on six datasets demonstrate that BioFormer outperforms 12 baselines, yielding absolute F1-score improvements of 6%.

</details>


### [444] [Neural Flow Operators can Approximate any Operator: Abstract Frameworks and Universal Approximations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22557)
*Shuang Chen,Juncai He,Xue-Cheng Tai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种抽象神经流框架，涵盖具有组合与分离结构的两种连续深度模型，适用于有限维函数逼近和无限维算子逼近，证明了适定性和通用逼近性质（包括首个无穷维空间间流模型的通用逼近结果），并通过时间离散化统一了残差网络和普通架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为神经网络和神经算子提供一个统一的连续深度流框架，并证明其在有限维和无限维空间中的通用逼近性质，特别是填补了流模型在无穷维空间中通用逼近理论的空白。

Method: 提出抽象神经流框架，包含两种连续深度模型：组合结构（composition structure）和分离结构（separation structure）。通过时间离散化，组合结构恢复ResNet型架构，分离结构通过分裂型离散化得到普通架构。覆盖全连接或卷积线性层的网络和算子。

Result: 证明了所提神经流的适定性和通用逼近性质，包括首个无穷维空间间流模型的通用逼近结果，以及卷积神经流模型的通用逼近结果。

Conclusion: 该框架通过流模型统一了残差架构和普通架构，为神经网络和神经算子提供了理论基础，并开辟了连续深度模型在算子学习中的应用方向。

Abstract: We introduce an abstract neural flow framework for neural networks and neural operators. The framework contains two continuous-depth models, namely neural flows with composition and separation structures, and covers both finite-dimensional function approximation and infinite-dimensional operator approximation. We prove well-posedness and universal approximation properties for the corresponding neural flows, including, to the best of our knowledge, the first universal approximation result for flow-based models between infinite-dimensional spaces. We also obtain universal approximation results for convolutional neural flow models. Through suitable time discretizations, the composition structure recovers ResNet-type architectures, while the separation structure, via a splitting-based discretization, yields plain architectures. This gives a unified flow-based route to both residual and plain architectures for neural networks and neural operators with fully connected or convolutional linear layers.

</details>


### [445] [CogAdapt: Transferring Clinical ECG Foundation Models to Wearable Cognitive Load Assessment via Lead Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22774)
*Amir Mousavi,Erfan Nourbakhsh,Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani,Mimi Xie,Rocky Slavin,Leslie Neely,John Davis,John Quarles*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CogAdapt框架，通过LeadBridge适配器将3导联可穿戴信号转换为12导联表示，并结合ProFine渐进微调策略，将临床心电图基础模型迁移至可穿戴设备的实时认知负荷评估任务，在CLARE和CL-Drive数据集上分别取得0.626和0.768的macro-F1分数，显著优于从头训练的基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时认知负荷评估对自适应人机交互至关重要，但面临标注数据有限和跨主体泛化能力差的问题。现有的临床心电图基础模型虽蕴含丰富表征，但由于传感器配置不匹配和任务差异，无法直接应用于可穿戴设备。

Method: 提出CogAdapt框架，包含两个核心组件：LeadBridge，一种可学习的适配器，将3导联可穿戴信号转换为解剖学一致的12导联表示；ProFine，一种渐进式微调策略，逐步解冻编码器层同时防止灾难性遗忘。

Result: 在CLARE和CL-Drive两个公开数据集上采用留一受试者交叉验证，CogAdapt显著优于从头训练的基线模型，macro-F1分别达到0.626和0.768。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，基础模型适配方法在基于可穿戴传感器的、与受试者无关的认知负荷评估中具有良好前景。

Abstract: Real-time cognitive load assessment is essential for adaptive human-computer interaction but remains challenging due to limited labeled data and poor cross-subject generalization. Recent ECG foundation models pre-trained on millions of clinical recordings offer rich representations, but cannot be directly applied to wearable devices due to sensor configuration mismatch and task differences. In this paper, we propose CogAdapt, a framework that adapts clinical ECG foundation models to wearable cognitive load assessment. CogAdapt introduces LeadBridge, a learnable adapter that transforms 3-lead wearable signals into anatomically consistent 12-lead representations, and ProFine, a progressive fine-tuning strategy that gradually unfreezes encoder layers while preventing catastrophic forgetting. Evaluations on two public datasets (CLARE and CL-Drive) under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation show that CogAdapt substantially outperforms baselines trained from scratch, achieving macro-F1 scores of 0.626 and 0.768. These results demonstrate the promise of foundation model adaptation for subject-independent cognitive load assessment from wearable sensors.

</details>


### [446] [Iterative Refinement Neural Operators are Learned Fixed-Point Solvers: A Principled Approach to Spectral Bias Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24041)
*Xiaotian Liu,Shuyuan Shang,Xiaopeng Wang,Pu Ren,Yaoqing Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出迭代细化神经算子（IRNO），通过固定点迭代的细化模块增强预训练算子，配合渐进谱损失解决高频细节的分辨难题。在物理系统测试中，湍流模拟误差降低56.05%，主动物质系统的高频误差比降至1.48-2.04%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经算子采用单次推理存在谱偏置，难以捕捉高频细节，限制了在科学建模中的精度。

Method: IRNO在预训练算子后添加可学习的细化模块，通过固定点迭代进行残差校正；并设计渐进谱损失，在训练中逐步增强对高频分量的惩罚。

Result: 湍流模拟误差降低56.05%；主动物质系统中，低、中、高频归一化误差比分别降至27.72-36.10%、5.07-6.68%、1.48-2.04%，且超越训练迭代次数后仍保持稳定。

Conclusion: IRNO通过迭代细化有效缓解了神经算子的谱偏置问题，显著提升了高频预测精度，且具有良好的泛化稳定性。

Abstract: Neural operators serve as fast, data-driven surrogates for scientific modeling but typically rely on a monolithic, single-pass inference procedure that struggles to resolve high-frequency details, a limitation known as spectral bias. We introduce the Iterative Refinement Neural Operator (IRNO), which augments pre-trained operators with a learned refinement module iteratively applied via fixed-point iteration. IRNO decomposes the prediction into a coarse initialization followed by successive residual corrections, paralleling classical numerical solvers. Under local assumptions, we establish contraction of the induced operator, ensuring convergence to a unique fixed point. To explicitly target high-frequency errors, we propose a progressive spectral loss that adaptively increases penalty on high-frequency components over refinement steps during training. Across physical systems, IRNO consistently lowers error, with up to 56.05% improvement on turbulent flow. On Active Matter, spectral analysis reveals that, relative to base operator, the normalized error ratios decrease to 27.72-36.10% in low-, 5.07-6.68% in mid-, and 1.48-2.04% in high-frequencies, remaining stable beyond the trained iteration count. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaotianliu-dartmouth/Iterative_Refinement_Neural_Operator

</details>


### [447] [Hidden-State Privacy Has an Empty Middle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24042)
*Alexander Okezue Bell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了高斯发布下的单层隐藏状态隐私问题，发现1536种高斯协方差中无一能在自适应检索攻击下同时实现中等效用和隐私。理论证明了Fisher球下界，指出对角逆Fisher发布机制是唯一的最优对角机制，但处于隐私/效用边界。通用特征机制在自适应Mahalanobis攻击下完全失效，而完整轨迹序列恢复器在对角机制下也完全失效。从头训练的分离记忆Transformer在固定token语言建模损失惩罚下维持显著优势，但预训练模型效果有限。这些结果将隐藏状态发布问题从高斯类机制设计重新定位为架构或发布协同设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究高斯发布机制在隐藏状态隐私保护中的有效性，发现现有机制无法同时兼顾效用与隐私，需要重新思考问题框架。

Method: 对1536种高斯发布协方差进行实证测试，提出Fisher球下界理论证明，设计对角逆Fisher发布机制，构建自适应Mahalanobis攻击者和完整轨迹序列恢复器，并训练分离记忆Transformer进行比较。

Result: 所有高斯机制均无法同时实现中等效用和隐私；对角逆Fisher机制是唯一最优但对隐私/效用边界敏感；通用特征机制在自适应攻击下完全失效；分离记忆Transformer显著优于同预算GPT基线但预训练模型效果有限。

Conclusion: 隐藏状态发布需要从高斯类机制设计转向架构或发布协同设计的新范式。

Abstract: Of $1{,}536$ Gaussian release covariances we tested for single-layer hidden-state privacy, zero achieve both moderate utility and moderate privacy against an adaptive retrieval attacker. We prove a complementary Fisher-ball lower bound: every full-rank Gaussian release at $O(1)$ Fisher utility admits a direction whose Mahalanobis signal grows linearly in hidden width, ruling out uniform Gaussian safety in the class and matching the empirical empty middle. The diagonal inverse-Fisher release $Σ^\star_{\mathrm{diag}}(\mathcal{K}) = (2\mathcal{K}/d)\,\mathrm{diag}(1/F_{ii})$ is the unique minimax-optimal diagonal mechanism at first-order KL budget $\mathcal{K}$ and the only release with worst-attacker top-1 $\le 0.001$ at every point of a 32 model-layer grid, but it sits on a privacy/utility edge rather than filling the middle. A generalized-eigen mechanism reaching $13\times$ Pareto reduction under Euclidean retrieval collapses to $100\%$ top-1 under the adaptive Mahalanobis attacker, and a full-trajectory sequence inverter recovers $94\%$ of clean GPT-2 prefixes but $0\%$ under $Σ_{\mathrm{diag}}$. A split-memory transformer trained from scratch reaches $G_{\mathrm{Mah}} \in [20, 33]$ at 90M and maintains a $6$--$24\times$ advantage over same-budget GPT baselines from 30M to 1B at a fixed-token language-modeling loss penalty; pretrained models top out at 9.3. These results reframe hidden-state release from mechanism-design within the Gaussian class to architecture or release co-design.

</details>


### [448] [Not All Transitions Matter: Evidence from PPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24071)
*Ajhesh Basnet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现强化学习on-policy训练中，由于轨迹的因果链导致连续转移之间存在信息冗余，使梯度信号重复、训练不稳定。作者提出在rollout中随机丢弃固定比例（25%）的转移，即可打破冗余、稳定训练，无需修改核心算法，在五个环境中与PPO匹配奖励表现且训练动态更一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy强化学习训练时，连续状态转移因agent自身动作因果链而存在高度依赖性和信息冗余，导致梯度信号重复、价值网络追赶策略变化困难、训练不稳定，而奖励曲线难以揭示该问题。本文旨在移除这种冗余以稳定训练。

Method: 在rollout中随机丢弃固定比例的转移（25%），在适当阶段操作以保证奖励信号完整。该方法仅需一个采样步骤，无需新增组件或修改核心算法，可适用于任何PPO实现。

Result: 在CartPole-v1、Acrobot-v1、LunarLander-v2、HalfCheetah-v5、Hopper-v5五个环境中，该方法在奖励指标上与标准PPO相当，但在KL散度、策略熵、价值估计上展现出更一致的训练动态。25%丢弃率为最优选择。

Conclusion: 简单的随机丢弃过渡可打破on-policy训练中的梯度冗余结构，稳定训练过程，且实现成本极低、兼容现有算法。

Abstract: Training a reinforcement learning agent on-policy means collecting fresh experience at every update, and that experience comes with a hidden problem. Each state in a rollout is the direct output of the previous one, causally chained together by the agent's own actions. Because of this, consecutive transitions are never truly independent. They carry overlapping information, and the gradient signal the network receives ends up far more repetitive than the batch size suggests. The same directions get reinforced over and over, the value network struggles to keep up as the policy shifts, and training becomes quietly unstable in ways that reward curves alone rarely reveal.
  This paper asks whether that redundancy can simply be removed. We show that randomly dropping a fixed fraction of transitions from the rollout, at the right stage so the reward signal stays intact, is enough to break the repetitive gradient structure and stabilize training. The change is minimal: one sampling step, no new components, no modification to the core algorithm, and it works with any PPO implementation. Across five environments of increasing difficulty, CartPole-v1, Acrobot-v1, LunarLander-v2, HalfCheetah-v5, and Hopper-v5, the method matches vanilla PPO on reward while producing more consistent training dynamics across KL divergence, policy entropy, and value estimates. Dropping 25% of transitions turns out to be the sweet spot: enough to disrupt the redundancy, not enough to thin the batch.

</details>


### [449] [Rethinking Weak Supervision in Anomaly Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26068)
*Xu Yao,Siyuan Zhou,Zhenbo Wu,Chaochuan Hou,Shuang Liang,Shiping Wang,Hailiang Huang,Songqiao Han,Minqi Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WSADBench是首个统一评估弱监督异常检测（WSAD）三种主要监督方向（不完全、不精确、不准确）的基准，通过标准化协议评估36种算法在4种模态上的表现，基于70多万次实验揭示了弱监督场景间的内在关联、不同方法在不同标签稀缺度下的性能边界、无标签数据的有限效用以及模型对标签噪声的不对称敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前WSAD的三个主要研究方向（不完全、不精确、不准确监督）相互孤立，缺乏统一框架来评估它们面临的是独特挑战还是共享基础机制，亟需一个标准化基准来系统比较这些方向。

Method: 提出了WSADBench基准，通过系统变化标签数量、粒度和质量，建立标准化评估协议，在4种模态上评估36种算法（包括专用WSAD方法、表格基础模型和通用分类方法），并执行了超过70万次实验。

Result: 发现了四个关键发现：(i)不同弱监督场景之间存在强内在相关性；(ii)专用WSAD算法仅在极端标签稀缺情况下表现优异，但随着监督增强或在OOD场景中，表格基础模型和通用分类方法迅速主导；(iii)无标签数据在不同设置下效用不一致，相比标签精炼增益有限；(iv)模型对不同类型的标签噪声表现出不对称敏感性。

Conclusion: WSADBench为WSAD领域提供了统一的评估框架，揭示了当前研究方向的局限性，指出了更有效利用数据和标签的方向，并以开源形式发布以促进未来研究。

Abstract: Weakly supervised anomaly detection (WSAD) has developed in three primary directions: incomplete, inexact, and inaccurate supervision. However, these directions remain isolated, lacking a unified framework to assess whether they address unique challenges or share fundamental mechanics. This paper introduces WSADBench, the first benchmark that unifies evaluation across distinct weakly supervised scenarios, benchmarking diverse approaches from specialized WSAD methods to advanced tabular foundation models. WSADBench establishes standardized protocols to evaluate 36 algorithms across 4 modalities by systematically varying label quantity, granularity, and quality, revealing the performance boundaries of various methods. Based on over 700K experiments, WSADBench reveals four critical insights: (i) Strong intrinsic correlations exist between these weak supervision scenarios, challenging the isolation of current research directions. (ii) Specialized WSAD algorithms excel only in extreme label-scarcity regimes but are quickly dominated by tabular foundation models and general classification methods as supervision increases or in OOD scenarios. (iii) Unlabeled data shows inconsistent utility across settings, with marginal gains compared to label refinement. (iv) Models exhibit asymmetric sensitivity to different types of label noise. We release WSADBench as an open-source benchmark with code and datasets to facilitate future WSAD research: https://github.com/SUFE-AILAB/WSADBench.

</details>


### [450] [Global Convergence of Wasserstein Policy Gradient for Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26078)
*Zhaoyu Zhu,Rui Gao,Shuang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了Wasserstein策略梯度（WPG）在熵正则化强化学习中的全局收敛理论，通过利用Bellman结构替代传统凸性假设，证明了WPG在连续控制问题中能够实现几何级收敛（至离散化偏差范围内）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WPG方法在连续控制问题中表现出色，但其全局收敛性质尚不明确。标准Langevin分析方法不适用，因为RL目标通过Bellman递归而非静态凸泛函依赖于策略，且Langevin漂移由软Q函数决定，其正则性需沿策略迭代加以控制。

Method: 利用熵正则化RL的Bellman结构：1）软Bellman残差具有关于Gibbs策略的状态级KL表示；2）Bellman压缩将残差与全局最优性间隙关联；3）Bellman预解恒等式将价值改进与相对Fisher信息连接。结合均匀log-Sobolev不等式，推导出分布Polyak–Łojasiewicz条件，并控制离散化误差所需的正则性和一致界。

Result: 建立了WPG的几何级收缩收敛性（至离散化偏差范围内），证明了熵正则化RL虽非传统凸问题，但Bellman递归诱导了有利于WPG全局收敛的PL型几何。

Conclusion: 熵正则化RL的Bellman结构提供了替代传统凸性的分析框架，使得WPG方法具备全局收敛保证。

Abstract: Wasserstein policy gradient (WPG) is a policy optimization method for reinforcement learning (RL) that exploits the optimal-transport geometry of action distributions. For the entropy-regularized RL objective, WPG evolves each state-conditional policy by transporting it along the action gradient of the soft Q-function together with a Langevin-type diffusion. Despite its appeal for continuous-control problems, its global convergence properties remain poorly understood. Standard Langevin analyses do not directly apply, because the RL objective depends on the policy through the Bellman recursion rather than through a static convex functional, and the Langevin drift is determined by the soft Q-function, whose regularity must be controlled along the policy iterates.
  In this paper, we develop a global convergence theory for WPG by exploiting the Bellman structure of entropy-regularized RL. We show that the role usually played by convexity can be replaced by a Bellman-based argument: the soft Bellman residual admits a statewise KL representation with respect to a Gibbs policy; Bellman contraction relates this residual to the global optimality gap; and a Bellman resolvent identity connects value improvement to relative Fisher information. Combined with a uniform log-Sobolev inequality (LSI) for the evolving Gibbs family, these ingredients yield a distributional Polyak--Łojasiewicz condition. We further establish the regularity and uniform bounds needed to control the discretization error, thereby obtaining geometric contraction up to a discretization bias. Conceptually, our analysis shows that although entropy-regularized RL is not convex in the usual flat sense, the Bellman recursion induces a favorable Polyak--Lojasiewicz-type (PL) geometry that supports global convergence of WPG.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [451] [When Does Adaptive Guidance Help? Belief-Aware Privileged Distillation for Autonomous Driving Under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26155)
*Mehmet Haklidir*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: BA-GSAC通过集成不确定性动态调节蒸馏系数λ，但在严重部分可观测场景下，自适应系数会崩溃至最小值。研究发现性能提升主要来自调度效应而非集成本身，简单的线性衰减策略表现最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GSAC使用固定的蒸馏系数λ，忽略了智能体的不确定性，无法根据观测质量动态调整教师知识蒸馏程度。

Method: 提出Belief-Aware GSAC (BA-GSAC)，利用集成不确定性（ensemble disagreement）动态调节蒸馏系数λ，并在Highway-Env上系统比较五种策略（固定λ∈{0.01,0.1}、自适应、线性衰减、vanilla SAC）在三种POMDP难度水平下的表现。

Result: 1) 在轻度和中度部分可观测条件下，自适应方法初步显示出优势；2) 在严重遮挡条件下，自适应系数约3K步内坍塌至λ_min；3) 线性衰减调度在严重POMDP下表现最佳（均值116.5，CV=8.9%）；4) 自适应策略的稳定性来自warmup阶段的调度效应（CV=13.3% vs 常数λ=0.01的29.8%）。

Conclusion: 自适应蒸馏的稳定性收益主要来自调度效应而非集成不确定性本身；集成预测目标的选择（全状态vs部分观测）是重要的设计决策；建议未来将集成模型训练于教师的特权全状态预测上。

Abstract: Guided Soft Actor-Critic (GSAC) distills knowledge from a privileged full-state teacher to a partial-observation student for autonomous driving, but uses a fixed distillation coefficient lambda regardless of the agent's uncertainty. We present Belief-Aware GSAC (BA-GSAC), which modulates lambda via ensemble disagreement, and use it as a testbed for a systematic empirical study asking: when does adaptive guidance actually help? Evaluating five strategies (fixed lambda in {0.01, 0.1}, adaptive, linear decay, and vanilla SAC) across three POMDP difficulty levels on Highway-Env, we find that preliminary single-seed runs suggest benefits under mild and moderate partial observability, but under severe occlusion (evaluated with 3 seeds for all methods) the adaptive coefficient collapses to lambda_min within about 3K steps. We trace this to an observability blindness phenomenon: because the ensemble predicts partial observations, it achieves low disagreement even under heavy occlusion, modeling what is visible but unable to detect what is missing. We diagnose the root cause and propose an architectural fix (training the ensemble on full-state predictions using the guiding actor's privileged access); while not validated here, we show that even with current limitations, the warmup phase provides measurable stabilization (CV=13.3% vs. 29.8% for constant lambda=0.01). In fact, a simple deterministic linear decay schedule achieves the best severe-POMDP performance across all metrics (mean 116.5, CV=8.9%), suggesting that the scheduling effect, not the ensemble, drives the stability benefit. These findings provide practical guidance for designing uncertainty-aware teacher-student frameworks and highlight ensemble prediction targets as an important design choice.

</details>


### [452] [Collaborative Navigation and Exploration with $β$-Sparse Gaussian Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26304)
*Evangelos Psomiadis,Dipankar Maity,Panagiotis Tsiotras*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了β-稀疏高斯过程框架，使移动传感器机器人在带宽受限下联合选择传输地图点和导航动作，预测未知环境区域，在火星和地球地图仿真中路径成本降低18%，传输信息减少76%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构机器人在未知环境中协作导航面临感知、通信和计算限制，尤其在带宽约束下如何高效共享局部环境信息以降低导航路径成本。

Method: 提出β-稀疏高斯过程（β-Sparse Gaussian Processes），一种鲁棒的变分稀疏高斯过程模型用于任务感知的诱导点选择；并开发了平衡任务相关性与探索的动作选择策略。

Result: 在火星和地球地图仿真中，相比无通信基线路径成本降低18%，相比原始数据传输基线传输信息减少76%。

Conclusion: 所提框架能有效在带宽约束下实现高效的异构机器人协作导航，显著降低路径成本并大幅减少所需传输的信息量。

Abstract: Collaborative navigation of heterogeneous robots in unknown environments poses significant challenges due to sensing, communication, and computational limitations. In this work, a lead robot navigates toward a target while a mobile sensor robot (e.g., a drone) assists by transmitting information about its locally observed environment under bandwidth constraints. We propose a framework that enables the sensor to jointly select its transmitted map points and navigation actions online, while also predicting unexplored regions of the environment. To this end, we present $β$-Sparse Gaussian Processes, a novel and robust variational sparse Gaussian Process model for task-aware inducing point selection. Furthermore, we develop an action-selection strategy that balances task relevance with exploration. Simulations on Mars and Earth maps show that the framework can reduce path cost by 18% relative to no communication and decrease transmitted information by 76% compared to raw-data transmission baselines.

</details>


### [453] [NightSight: Passive Computation for Navigation in Dark Using Events](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26330)
*Deepak Singh,Brijan Vaghasiya,Shreyas Khobragade,Nitin Sanket*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级感知方法，结合单目事件相机、编码孔径镜头和红外点阵投影器，使小型空中机器人在完全黑暗环境中实现自主导航。通过投影图案经编码孔径成像产生深度相关的模糊特征，利用仅由简单平面墙壁合成数据训练的CNN网络解码为稠密深度图，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上以20Hz实时运行，2.5m范围内L1误差7.0cm（2.80%），并零样本泛化到复杂真实场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型空中机器人在搜救任务中优势显著，但完全黑暗环境下的自主导航面临挑战——小型平台难以承载需要大载荷、高功耗或强计算能力的感知系统，现有方法无法在资源受限条件下实现黑暗中的稠密深度估计。

Method: 提出轻量级感知方案：(1)硬件组合：单目事件相机+编码孔径镜头+红外点阵投影器；(2)原理：投影点阵经编码孔径成像产生与深度相关的模糊特征（depth dependent blur signatures）；(3)算法：训练CNN网络解码模糊特征得到稠密深度图，训练仅使用简单平面墙壁场景的合成数据；(4)部署：NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上实时运行。

Result: 系统在20Hz实时运行；零样本泛化到复杂真实场景；2.5m范围内L1误差7.0cm（相对误差2.80%）；分析了不同编码孔径设计对深度估计性能的影响。

Conclusion: 结合结构光照明、编码光学和事件相机感知，能够在完全黑暗环境中实现高精度鲁棒的深度感知与导航，为资源受限的小型空中机器人提供可行方案，展示了该技术路线的潜力。

Abstract: Small aerial robots are particularly well-suited for search and rescue in confined and hazardous environments due to their agility, low cost, and ability to traverse through cluttered spaces that are inaccessible to larger platforms. However, enabling autonomous navigation in complete darkness remains a significant challenge, because small aerial robots cannot easily accommodate perception systems that demand substantial payload, power, or computation. In this work, we present a lightweight perception approach that combines a monocular event camera, a coded aperture lens, and an infrared dot projector to enable navigation in such conditions. The projected pattern, when imaged through the coded aperture, produces depth dependent blur signatures that implicitly encode scene geometry. We train a convolutional neural network to decode these signatures into dense depth maps using only synthetic data generated from a simple planar wall setup. Despite this minimal training regime, the model generalizes zero-shot to complex real-world scenes. Our system operates in real time at 20 Hz on a NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, demonstrating suitability for resource-constrained platforms. We further analyze the impact of different coded aperture designs on depth estimation performance. Our approach gives high accuracy (l1 error 7.0cm) upto 2.5m range (2.80% error). These results highlight the potential of combining structured illumination, coded optics, and event-based sensing for enabling robust perception and navigation in complete darkness.

</details>


### [454] [RCSP: Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning for Safe Dynamic Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26348)
*Zhengye Han,Quanyan Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出风险敏感猜想场景规划（RCSP）方法，通过评估候选指令对短时障碍物未来的影响，解决移动机器人在动态瓶颈场景中的预测性近失问题。在MuJoCo和ROS2/Gazebo仿真中，RCSP提高了次级安全性和路径质量，减少了动态近失故障，但在严格基准成功率上不如调优后的DWA和TEB，表明其作为现有导航栈的补充预测风险模块的定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人在动态环境中可能面临“预测性近失”问题：当前安全的运动速度可能使机器人陷入即将被移动障碍物封闭的通道，导致碰撞。现有方法缺乏对短时未来交互风险的前瞻性评估。

Method: RCSP包含四个步骤：1) 维护关于局部运动猜想的轻量级信念分布；2) 采样未来交互场景；3) 对高风险尾部进行惩罚；4) 通过局部安全检查执行候选指令。整体作为规划层对候选命令进行评估。

Result: 在MuJoCo瓶颈任务中，RCSP成功到达目标且无碰撞，在次级安全性和路径质量估计上优于非自适应基线，但增加了延迟。在ROS2/Gazebo中，将局部安全层添加到标准Nav2栈可减少动态近失故障。在官方DynaBARN/Jackal迁移测试中，调优后的DWA和TEB在严格基准成功率上仍更强。

Conclusion: RCSP作为预测性风险模块，能够有效补充现有导航栈在动态瓶颈场景中的不足，但其边界在于严格成功率指标上仍不及传统调优方法，适合作为辅助安全层而非完全替代方案。

Abstract: Mobile robots can fail before they collide: a velocity that is safe now may commit the robot to a passage that moving obstacles will soon close. We study this predictive near-miss commitment problem and propose Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning (RCSP), a planning layer that evaluates candidate commands against plausible short-horizon obstacle futures. RCSP maintains a lightweight belief over local motion conjectures, samples future interactions, penalizes high-risk tails, and executes through a local safety check. In controlled MuJoCo bottleneck tasks, the RCSP planner reaches the goal without collisions and yields higher secondary safety and path-quality point estimates than a non-adaptive predictor, with additional latency. In ROS2/Gazebo, adding the local safety layer to a standard Nav2 stack reduces dynamic near-miss failures. On official DynaBARN/Jackal transfer, tuned DWA and TEB remain stronger on strict benchmark success, revealing the boundary of the approach. These simulation results position RCSP as a predictive-risk module that complements existing navigation stacks in dynamic bottleneck regimes.

</details>


### [455] [Closing the Loop in Teleoperation: Episode-Level Data Quality Assessment and Feedback for High-Quality Demonstration Collection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26349)
*Gokul Narayanan,Yash Shahapurkar,Melih Erdogan,Brian Zhu,Eugen Solowjow*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出数据质量评估与反馈(DQAF)框架，在遥操作数据收集中为操作员提供即时后置反馈，帮助新手更快生成高质量演示数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业自动化正从刚性系统向灵活自适应系统转型，需要大规模真实机器人演示数据。然而新手操作员遥操作产生的演示虽任务成功但存在运动低效、重复修正、靠近关节极限等次优问题，缺乏即时质量反馈机制。

Method: 构建DQAF框架，提取子任务进度、运动平滑度、停滞、运动学极限等质量相关信号，将其转化为结构化质量评估和可操作的自然语言反馈，在每次遥操作后立即提供。

Result: 诊断验证中系统与人类审核员在拒绝原因和改进建议上一致性好；三人两任务的初步用户研究显示，接收即时反馈的操作员相比未接收者更快提升、更早产出高质量演示。

Conclusion: DQAF框架能有效帮助新手遥操作员提高演示数据质量，且自动化反馈可替代部分人类审核工作，对大规模高质量机器人数据收集有实际价值。

Abstract: Industrial automation is at a pivotal moment, as Physical AI is driving a transition from rigid, hand-engineered automation systems toward more flexible and adaptive systems. This shift has created a growing demand for large-scale, real-world robot demonstration data, making teleoperation an increasingly important mechanism for data collection. However, high-quality teleoperated demonstrations remain difficult to obtain in practice, as novice operators often produce episodes that are task-successful but suboptimal for downstream use due to inefficient motion, repeated corrections, or operation near robot joint limits. We present a Data Quality Assessment and Feedback (DQAF) framework that closes the loop in teleoperation by providing immediate post-episode feedback grounded in semantic task progress and robot telemetry. The framework extracts quality relevant signals such as sub-task progress, motion smoothness, stalls, kinematic limits and converts them into structured quality assessments and actionable natural-language feedback. Unlike binary success or failure feedback, the proposed system explains why an episode is suboptimal and highlights specific behaviors to correct in the next trial. We evaluate the framework through a diagnostic validation study and a pilot user study. In the validation study, the system is compared with a human reviewer during dataset curation, producing rejection reasons and actionable feedback for improvement. In the pilot study with three novice operators across two manipulation tasks, the operator who received the systems immediate, automated post-episode feedback improved faster than those who did not, producing higher-quality demonstrations sooner.

</details>


### [456] [Multi-Robot Box Transport over Different Surfaces with Decentralized Role-based Proportional Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26430)
*Aditya Bhatt,Himavarshini Yarragangu,Urvish Shah,Venkata Sai Yaswanth Mohan Thota,Souma Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为R2P2的异步去中心化任务与运动规划方法，用于多机器人协作推送运输矩形箱子。通过角色分配（推、支撑、阻止）和基于规则/比例控制，R2P2能够适应不同倾斜度和摩擦系数的地形，并在六机器人仿真和四机器人物理实验中展示了优于标准虚拟领导者-跟随者方法的成功率和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人协作运输在建筑、仓储和灾后清理等场景中有广泛应用，但不同倾斜度和摩擦系数的地形给协作运输带来了独特挑战。现有方法往往依赖同步通信和集中控制，存在单点故障等问题。

Method: 提出R2P2（Roles with Rules and Proportional-control Primitive）方法：首先根据操作模式（箱子旋转 vs 平移）通过规则为机器人分配角色（推、支撑、阻止），然后根据角色执行基于规则的控制或比例速度控制。每个机器人仅需观测自身和箱子的位置与朝向，以异步去中心化方式执行任务。

Result: 在NVIDIA IsaacSim仿真中，使用六机器人团队评估R2P2，展示了在不同表面摩擦/倾斜度和箱子质量场景下的泛化能力，成功率优于标准虚拟领导者-跟随者方法。物理实验中，四台Turtlebot成功运输了1.2kg的箱子。

Conclusion: R2P2作为一种去中心化方法，有效减轻了通信、同步和共识需求，缓解了单点故障问题，并在多地形多机器人协作推送任务中实现了优于对比方法的性能。

Abstract: Collaborative transport of objects via pushing by multiple robots has many applications, ranging from construction and warehouse environments to post disaster debris clean-up. Achieving collaborative transport over surfaces with different inclination and friction properties however poses unique challenges. To address these challenges, this paper presents an asynchronous decentralized task and motion planning approach for transporting rectangular boxes of varying mass over flat, uphill and downhill terrain. Such a decentralized approach alleviates communication, synchronization and consensus needs and mitigates single point of failure issues. Our approach, called R2P2 or Roles with Rules and Proportional-control Primitive, assigns roles (e.g., push, support and prevent) to robots based on rules cognizant of the mode of manipulation needed (box rotation vs translation); this is followed by either rule-based control or proportional control of robot velocity based on the roles. Each robot is assumed to observe the location and heading of self and the box in executing the role and controls. R2P2 is evaluated with a six-robot team deployed in a simulator built using NVIDIA IsaacSim -- demonstrating generalizability across different surface friction/inclination and box mass scenarios, and better success rate compared to a standard virtual-leader-follower method. R2P2 is also successfully validated with a physical experiment, where it is executed onboard four turtlebots tasked with moving a 1.2 kg box.

</details>


### [457] [Robust Koopman Control Barrier Filters for Safe Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26452)
*Dhruv S. Kushwaha,Zoleikha A. Biron*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Robust Koopman-CBF SAC框架，通过数据驱动的Koopman预测器学习提升空间中的CBF约束，并结合投影残差边界的鲁棒化处理，实现无模型强化学习下的零违规安全控制，同时揭示了线性EDMD模型在高维任务中的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CBF方法依赖准确动力学模型和手工设计的障碍函数，限制了其在无模型RL中的应用。本文旨在弥合无模型RL与可证明安全控制之间的鸿沟。

Method: 1) 从数据中学习有限维Koopman预测器，在提升空间中构造仿射CBF约束；2) 通过二次规划安全层实施约束；3) 利用由留出轨迹数据估计的投影残差边界收紧CBF条件以鲁棒化；4) 评论家在执行的安全动作上训练，演员则向Koopman-CBF可行集正则化。

Result: 在CartPole稳定与跟踪任务上实现零约束违规，回报与SAC持平或更优；在Safety Gymnasium高维任务中部分场景减少违规，但也暴露出速度势垒和线性EDMD模型的局限性。

Conclusion: 鲁棒Koopman-CBF滤波器是无模型RL与可证明安全之间有前景的桥梁，但高维任务下需高阶和多步Koopman-CBF扩展。

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) for robotic systems requires policies that improve task performance while satisfying state and input constraints during both training and deployment. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a principled mechanism for enforcing forward invariance through minimally invasive safety filters, but their use in model-free RL is limited by the need for accurate dynamics and hand-designed barrier certificates. We propose Robust Koopman-CBF SAC, a safety-filtered actor--critic framework that learns a finite-dimensional Koopman predictor from data, constructs affine CBF constraints in the lifted space, and enforces them through a quadratic-program safety layer. To account for finite-dimensional Koopman approximation error, the CBF condition is tightened using a projected residual margin estimated from held-out rollout data. The critic is trained on the executed safe action, while the actor is regularized toward the Koopman-CBF feasible set, reducing dependence on the filter over training. Across safe-control benchmarks, the method achieves zero constraint violations on CartPole stabilization and tracking while matching or exceeding unconstrained SAC returns. On high-dimensional Safety Gymnasium locomotion tasks, the method reduces violations in some settings but also exposes important limitations of first-order velocity barriers and linear EDMD models, motivating high-order and multi-step Koopman-CBF extensions. These results suggest that robust Koopman-CBF filters are a promising bridge between model-free RL and certifiable safety, while clarifying the structural conditions under which such filters remain effective. All code is available at \href{https://github.com/DhruvKushwaha/Koopman-CBF-Soft-Actor-Critic}{Github Repository}.

</details>


### [458] [Heterogeneous AAV Logistics Task Allocation: A Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Overlapping Coalition Formation Game Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26471)
*Yuze Zhou,Jingliang Sun,Junzhi Li,Jianxin Zhong,Zihan Wang,Teng Long*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对动态城市物流中异构AAV的随机时间敏感任务分配问题，提出了一种强化学习增强的重叠联盟形成博弈方法。通过Transformer-based SAC网络学习自适应策略引导联盟更新，在32架AAV和80个任务的场景下实现成本降低39.76%，并证明了该联盟形成过程构成精确势博弈，收敛于纳什稳定均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态城市物流中，随机出现的时效敏感任务对异构AAV物流任务分配的最优性构成重大挑战，现有方法难以处理时变任务集和异构资源的协同优化。

Method: 建立了动态任务分配模型，用耦合服务质量与资源消耗的广义物流成本量化全局最优性；设计了Transformer-based软演员-评论家（SAC）网络，利用多头自注意力编码变长物流状态并捕获任务间时空依赖，学习自适应策略替代启发式规则指导重叠联盟形成。

Result: 数值仿真表明算法有效提升任务分配最优性，在32架AAV和80个任务的场景中，相比启发式OCF基线实现39.76%的成本降低；室内飞行实验验证了实用性。

Conclusion: 所提出的联盟形成过程构成精确势博弈，保证在有限迭代次数内收敛到纳什稳定均衡，该算法有效提升了动态异构AAV物流任务分配的全局最优性。

Abstract: In dynamic urban logistics, the stochastic emergence of time-sensitive tasks poses a significant optimality challenge for heterogeneous AAVs logistics task allocation. To address this problem, a reinforcement learning enhanced overlapping coalition formation game approach is proposed. A dynamic task allocation model is established, where global optimality is mathematically quantified by a generalized logistics cost coupling service quality and resource consumption. To deal with the time-varying task sets induced by stochastic order arrivals, a transformer-based soft actor-critic network is designed. By leveraging multi-head self-attention to encode variable-length logistics states and capture task-wise spatiotemporal dependencies, the learned policy adaptively guides coalition updates, replacing heuristic rules in the overlapping coalition formation game. On this basis, heterogeneous AAVs can form more efficient overlapping coalitions for dynamic logistics tasks. The resulting coalition formation process is proven to constitute an exact potential game, which guarantees convergence to a Nash-stable equilibrium within a finite number of iterations. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm effectively improves the optimality of task allocation under the generalized logistics cost criterion. In a scenario with 32 AAVs and 80 tasks, our algorithm achieves a 39.76% cost reduction compared with the heuristic OCF baseline. Indoor flight experiments further validate its practicality.

</details>


### [459] [Efficient On-policy Visual-RL via Stochastic Decoupled Policy Gradient](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26478)
*Haoxiang You,Yilang Liu,Davis Zong,Qian Wang,Teeratham Vitchutripop,Qi Wang,Daniel Rakita,Ian Abraham*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出随机解耦策略梯度（SDPG），一种轻量级视觉强化学习方法，可在单个RTX 4080 GPU上数小时内端到端训练多样化的视觉运动控制策略，在视觉MuJoCo基准上显著优于基线方法，并展示了从仿真到真实硬件的有效迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉强化学习方法通常需要大量批渲染环境和昂贵的计算资源，训练时间长、内存开销大，限制了其在真实机器人控制任务中的实用性。

Method: SDPG通过轨迹rollout的随机扰动来估计策略梯度，大幅减少了批渲染环境的需求，降低了计算和内存开销。

Result: 在视觉MuJoCo基准上，SDPG在训练时间、内存使用和奖励方面均持续优于基线方法；在灵巧操作、挑战性运动等真实感视觉机器人基准上验证了有效性，并实现了仿真到真实硬件的成功迁移。

Conclusion: SDPG是一种高效、轻量的视觉RL方法，能够在有限计算资源下快速训练多样化的视觉运动控制策略，具备良好的sim-to-real迁移能力，为未来视觉机器人学习研究提供了新的基准。

Abstract: We present the stochastic decoupled policy gradient (SDPG), a lightweight visual reinforcement learning (RL) method that trains diverse visuomotor control policies end-to-end within a few hours on a single NVIDIA RTX 4080 GPU. SDPG estimates policy gradients via random perturbations of trajectory rollouts, requiring orders of magnitude fewer batch-rendered environments and substantially reducing compute and memory overhead. On visual MuJoCo benchmarks, SDPG consistently outperforms baseline methods in training time, memory usage, and rewards. Finally, to support future research, we introduce a suite of realistic visual robotics benchmarks spanning dexterous manipulation, challenging locomotion, and demonstrate effective sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware.

</details>


### [460] [Provably Safe Motion Planning Under Unknown Disturbances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26625)
*Ibon Gracia,Qi Heng Ho,Luca Laurenti,Morteza Lahijanian*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一种受随机扰动（分布未知）的机器人系统的可证明安全的**采样运动规划算法**，通过学习轨迹数据的Wasserstein模糊管（ambiquity tube），在机会约束下实现概率完备的运动规划，并通过降维模糊管和基于bandit的有效性检查器提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有采样运动规划算法在随机扰动分布未知的场景下难以保证安全约束的满足，亟需一种能够从数据中学习不确定性边界并保持概率完备性的方法。

Method: 1) 从系统轨迹数据学习**Wasserstein模糊管**（一系列模糊集），以高置信度包含状态分布轨迹；2) 将模糊管集成进**概率完备**的采样运动规划树中；3) 通过学习多个**低维模糊管**替代单个高维模糊管降低保守性；4) 设计**基于bandit的有效性检查器**提升经验性能。

Result: 在杂乱环境及严格安全阈值下，算法能够找到有效规划路径，性能优于现有最优方法。

Conclusion: 所提算法在扰动分布未知的条件下实现了可证明安全的运动规划，降维模糊管策略有效缓解了保守性，bandit检查器在保证概率完备性的前提下显著提高了计算效率。

Abstract: We present a provably safe sampling-based motion planning algorithm for robotic systems affected by random disturbances of unknown distribution. We consider systems with linear or linearizable dynamics evolving in workspace with arbitrary-shaped obstacles subject to state and control constraints. Safety requirements are formulated as chance-constraints. Our approach leverages data from trajectories of the system to learn a Wasserstein ambiguity tube, i.e., a sequence of ambiguity sets, which contains the trajectory of the system's state distribution with high confidence. This ambiguity tube is then used in a probabilistically complete algorithm to grow a sampling-based motion planning tree that respects the constraints of the problem. We show that learning several lower-dimensional ambiguity tubes instead of a single high-dimensional one effectively reduces the conservatism and boosts scalability. Additionally, we design an efficient bandit-based validity checker that remarkably increases the empirical performance of our approach without sacrificing probabilistic completeness. Case studies show our algorithm finds valid plans in cluttered environments under strict safety thresholds, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [461] [Enabling Extensible Embodied Capabilities with Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26637)
*Xueyang Zhou,Zijia Wang,Qianjiang Li,Yibo Hu,Guiyao Tie,Li Wan,Yidan Liu,Pan Zhou,Lichao Sun,Yongchao Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出能力外化方法，通过标准化工具协议ETP将具身智能中的异构能力解耦为独立工具，构建EmbodiedToolBench基准，实验表明该方法平均提升31%-36%性能，但执行类能力提升有限，且模型在工具调用时机、选择和方式上仍存在挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能方法将感知、推理、规划和控制统一在单一参数化策略中，但这些能力本质上是层次化和异构的，难以在单个模型中可靠学习和模块化。

Method: 提出能力外化方法，将异构能力解耦为独立优化工具；引入ETP标准化协议用于工具注册、发现、调用和执行；构建100+验证工具的EmbodiedToolBench基准。

Result: 在EB-ALFRED和EB-Navigation上分别平均提升31%和36%；认知和感知类能力提升显著，执行类能力提升有限；模型在知道何时、选择哪个以及如何调用工具方面仍面临挑战。

Conclusion: 能力外化方法能有效提升具身智能性能，但执行类能力是瓶颈；工具调用能力（时机、选择、方式）是未来研究的关键方向。

Abstract: Most existing embodied intelligence methods formulate perception, reasoning, planning, and control within a unified parameterized policy. Yet these capabilities are inherently hierarchical and heterogeneous, making them difficult to reliably learn and modularize within a single model. We propose a capability externalization approach that decouples heterogeneous capabilities into independently optimized tools, dynamically invoked at inference time. To this end, we introduce Embodied Tool Protocol (ETP), a standardized protocol for embodied tool registration, discovery, invocation, and execution, and curate 100+ validated tools spanning perception, cognition, reasoning, and execution as the tool base. Building on this, we construct EmbodiedToolBench to evaluate both whether tool augmentation improves embodied performance and how well current models use tools across tool-necessity recognition, tool selection, tool execution, and tool-chain composition. Experiments across simulation and real-world platforms confirm that capability externalization consistently improves embodied performance (avg. gain 31% on EB-ALFRED and 36% on EB-Navigation), yet reveal a clear boundary: gains are substantial for cognition and perception but are limited for execution-type capabilities. Moreover, our analysis reveals that knowing when, which, and how to invoke tools remains a persistent challenge across all models, thereby highlighting embodied tool competence as a critical direction for future research.

</details>


### [462] [HyperSim: A Holistic Sim-To-Real Framework For Robust Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26638)
*Junyi Dong,Haotian Luo,Ziwei Xu,Shengwei Bian,Heng Zhang,Sitong Mao,Jingyi Guo,Yang Xu,Wenhao Chen,Qiuyu Feng,Yao Mu,Ping Luo,Shunbo Zhou,Xiaodong Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HyperSim是一个从合成数据生成到策略训练再到真实世界部署的全流程框架，通过高保真环境合成、对抗轨迹生成和仿真-真实协同训练三大核心模块系统性地缩小仿真到现实的域差距，在400次真实任务执行中分别达到80% (ACT)和95% (π₀)的仿真到现实成功率，并在物理扰动下实现35%更高的任务完成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
